articles.title: The public health challenges of children's and adolescents' digital media use: applying the digital determinants of health as an interpretive framework
articles.authors: Holly L, Raeside R, Morton A, Shi J, Padmapriya N, Müller-Riemenschneider F, Digital Determinants of Health Youth Advisory Group

abstract.text: Children and adolescents are growing up in a hybrid world in which digital media has become part of the infrastructure of everyday life and a structural determinant of their health. In the second paper of this Series on the digital determinants of health, we apply the framework introduced in the first paper to one of the most contested questions in public health: how young people's digital media use shapes their health and wellbeing. Using the digital determinants of health framework to interpret the current evidence base, we examine what is known, and what remains poorly understood, about the public health implications of children's and adolescents' digital media use. Evidence suggests that digital media use can be associated with both benefits and harms although it is more consistently associated with adverse mental, behavioural, physical, cognitive, and social outcomes, with developmental stage emerging as an important moderator. Illustrative modelling indicates the potential population burden is substantial, even as its causal basis remains uncertain. Research to date has privileged easily measured proxies, such as screen time, and given insufficient attention to the platform design, algorithmic systems, and commercial incentives that shape young people's experiences. Situating young people's digital media use with a digital determinants of health framework, we conclude that protecting children's and adolescents' health calls for a precautionary, structural response-one that moves beyond individual behaviour change to reshape the digital systems, incentives, and knowledge practices that determine how digital media affects health.

articles.title: Governing the digital determinants of health for children and young people: a global public health imperative
articles.authors: Prainsack B, Medhora RP, Kickbusch I

abstract.text: The digital determinants of health are the structural conditions through which digital infrastructures, business models, and design choices shape health outcomes. Yet these determinants remain largely outside public health policy and remain fragmented across regulatory sectors. Rather than regulating individual technologies in isolation, governance should ensure that digital systems and environments advance population health and reduce inequities. A public health approach shifts attention from individual responsibility-and the tendency to blame users-towards the governance of the structural features that produce health risks and inequities. We identify four governance domains for the digital determinants of health: infrastructure and access, platform design and commercial practices, data governance and surveillance, and institutional accountability and rights. Effectively governing these domains requires intersectoral strategies that tackle problematic concentrations of political and economic power. We argue that the governance of the digital determinants of health should be recognised as a core public health function, with the health of children and young people as a priority and entry point and precaution as a guiding governance principle.
abstract.textZh: 健康的數位決定因素是數位基礎設施、商業模式和設計選擇塑造健康結果的結構條件。 然而，這些決定因素在很大程度上仍然在公共衛生政策之外，並且在各個監管部門中仍然是分散的。 治理應確保數位系統和環境促進人口健康並減少不平等，而不是孤立地監管個別技術。 公共衛生方法將注意力從個人責任（以及將責任歸咎於用戶的傾向）轉向對產生健康風險和不公平的結構特徵的治理。 我們為健康的數位決定因素確定了四個治理領域：基礎設施和存取、平臺設計和商業實踐、數據治理和監控，以及機構責任和權利。 有效治理這些領域需要跨部門戰略來解決政治和經濟權力集中的問題。 我們認為，應將數位健康決定因素的治理視為核心公共衛生功能，以兒童和青少年的健康為優先，以切入點和預防措施為指導治理原則。

articles.title: The digital determinants of health: a new era for global public health
articles.authors: Shaw J, Gross N, Saldaña-Tejeda A, Atuire C, Prainsack B, Holly L, Kickbusch I

abstract.text: Digital transformations exert increasing influence over the lives of the global population, shaping opportunities and generating harms for health and wellbeing across the spectrum of digital access and engagement. The scale of influence of digital transformations on human and planetary health marks the urgency of attention to the digital determinants of health (DDoH). In this Series paper, we describe a prevailing digital sociotechnological order (DSTO) as the structural source of the DDoH. The DSTO is composed of a set of dominant assumptions that motivate digital practices operating through four features (political norms, economic logics, infrastructures, and personal and social practices) to affect human and planetary health. We describe the implications of the DSTO for understanding, studying, and governing the DDoH, and present recommendations for future work.
abstract.textZh: 數位轉型對全球人口的生活產生越來越大的影響，在數位存取和參與的範圍內塑造機會並對健康和福祉產生危害。數位轉型對人類和地球健康的影響規模，標誌著迫切需要關注健康的數位決定因素(DDoH)。在本系列論文中，我們描述了流行的數字社會技術秩序（ DSTO ）作為DDoH的結構來源。DSTO由一組主要假設組成，這些假設通過四種特徵（政治規範、經濟邏輯、基礎設施以及個人和社會實踐）來激勵數字實踐，以影響人類和地球健康。我們描述了DSTO對理解、研究和管理DDoH的影響，並為未來的工作提出建議。

articles.title: Understanding peripheral arterial disease in the current era
articles.authors: Behrendt CA, Norgren L, Nicolajsen CW, Powell JT, Chuter V, Gupta PC, Woo K, Nordanstig J

abstract.text: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease is the primary driver of premature death in global populations in recent decades. Mortality statistics, most publications, and guidelines in the atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease field have traditionally focused on cardiac and cerebrovascular adverse events and causes of death. However, given the increasing prevalence of lower extremity peripheral arterial disease and its expanding burden on global health systems, such an emphasis might represent a skewed perception of vascular risk within the broader atherosclerotic spectrum. Although common risk factors appear similar in all atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease subgroups, several crucial differences exist, including pathophysiological details and lesion patterns, as well as adherence to guideline-based recommendations. Individuals with peripheral arterial disease frequently remain asymptomatic for many years, often decades, and are typically diagnosed only at an advanced stage of the condition. By this time, however, the expected long-term outcomes are already extremely poor. When diagnosed at this point, the overall 5-year mortality is between 30% and 50%, thus even surpassing outcomes of severe cancer and acute myocardial infarction. Compared with cardiac and cerebrovascular disease, peripheral arterial disease receives lower priority in research and clinical practice, which is compounded by poor patient adherence to preventive care, lifestyle modification, and pharmacological therapy. This clinical Series of three papers aims to improve this distressing situation. For this purpose, it is important to recognise the underacknowledgment, underdiagnosis, and undertreatment of peripheral arterial disease and to understand the complex inter-relationships behind it before suitable interdisciplinary measures can be initiated. In this Series paper, we want to reach the broad interdisciplinary community, and above all, those who see these patients every day in general practice and internal medicine. The focus is primarily on the global importance of peripheral atherosclerosis and its drivers. In paper 2 of this Series, readers are introduced to modern complementary therapy, ranging from the optimisation of risk factors and optimal pharmacological therapies to innovative endovascular procedures and traditional surgical treatments. In the sense of integrated care and a stepwise approach, the described therapy alternatives can be combined individually for each patient. Paper 3 of this Series provides readers with a deep insight into the global significance and burden of peripheral arterial disease. Since this disease is primarily characterised by its long-term, chronically progressive course, improving long-term outcomes represents a central aspect of this paper. It aims to further illuminate striking disparities between geographical regions, sexes, and socioeconomic groups. With strong recommendations, this clinical Series can help to guide both clinicians and policy makers towards effective preventive measures.

articles.title: Current advancements in the care of peripheral arterial disease: modern approaches to medical, endovascular, and surgical treatment
articles.authors: Tulamo R, Bradbury A, Hicks CW, Gottsäter A, Gupta PC, Rother U, Sigvant B, Hinchliffe R

abstract.text: People with peripheral arterial disease (PAD) of the lower limbs are at very high risk of cardiovascular events and therefore the cornerstone of their management is medical therapy and behaviour modification to reduce that risk. The risk of limb loss (through major amputation) is low in people with asymptomatic PAD or intermittent claudication with only a few patients progressing to the most severe form of PAD: chronic limb threatening ischaemia. Supervised exercise therapy is effective in patients with intermittent claudication to improve their walking capacity and avoids the risks associated with revascularisation procedures to improve blood flow to the limb. Although some people with intermittent claudication might need revascularisation, it is overused in this group. Revascularisation of stenosed or occluded arteries can be done by open or endovascular surgery and is generally reserved for people with chronic limb threatening ischaemia who are at highest risk of limb loss because these interventions carry substantial peri-procedural risks and often have minimal durability. Innovative therapies to treat PAD focus on improving health-related quality of life, reducing limb loss, and improving survival but the disease remains challenging due to its impact on multiple arterial levels and in different organ systems (polyvascular disease).
abstract.textZh: 患有下肢外周動脈疾病（ PAD ）的人患心血管疾病的風險非常高，因此其管理的基石是藥物治療和行為矯正以降低這種風險。 患有無症狀性PAD或間歇性跛行患者的肢體喪失（通過嚴重截肢）風險較低，只有少數患者進展到最嚴重的PAD形式：慢性肢體威脅性缺血。 監督運動療法對間歇性跛行患者有效，以改善他們的行走能力，並避免與血運重建程序相關的風險，以改善四肢的血流。 雖然一些間歇性跛行的人可能需要血運重建，但在這一組中被過度使用。 狹窄或閉塞動脈的血管再通可以通過開放式或血管內手術進行，並且通常保留給患有慢性肢體威脅性缺血的人，這些人肢體損失的風險最高，因為這些幹預措施具有很大的術前風險，並且通常具有最小的耐久性。 用於治療PAD的創新療法專注於改善與健康有關的生活質量、減少肢體損失和提高存活率，但由於其對多個動脈水平和不同器官系統（多血管疾病）的影響，該疾病仍然具有挑戰性。

articles.title: Peripheral arterial disease: adverse impacts, disparities in outcomes, and the path ahead
articles.authors: Golledge J, Søgaard M, Svensson M, Gupta PC, Nikol S, Reis PEO, Mahlmann A, Fowkes FGR

abstract.text: This is the third paper in the peripheral arterial disease (PAD) Series. The first and second papers in this Series outline that PAD affects over 300 million people worldwide and can be diagnosed by non-invasive tests, as well as that treatment requires medications to reduce modifiable risk factors and that exercise therapy and revascularisation are required in selected patients. In this paper, the devastating effects of PAD at the individual level are described, including chronic pain, functional limitation, loss of independence, impaired physical and mental quality of life, unemployment, and financial instability. Individuals with PAD are also at high risk of major adverse events, including major amputation, myocardial infarction, stroke, and death. The burden of PAD falls heavily on underserved groups, including women, First Nations Peoples globally, other non-White individuals, patients with financial insecurities, and those living in remote areas. Recommendations to advance PAD management are presented and include short-term changes, such as improving disease awareness and introducing multidisciplinary models of care that deliver more holistic medical and rehabilitation care, as well as long-term changes, such as testing whether screening and initiation of early medical management can reduce the burden of PAD. Furthermore, modification of health-care services is needed to provide better access for underserved, rural and remote, First Nations, and low-income populations.

articles.title: Most-favoured-nation pricing for prescription drugs in US Medicare: a cohort study
articles.authors: Hwang TJ, Hediger S, Krishnan A, Cai CL, Kesselheim AS, Vokinger KN

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The prices of new medicines in the USA are among the highest in the world. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services released mandatory most-favoured-nation payment models for prescription drugs covered under Medicare part B (GLOBE) and part D (GUARD). Under these payment models, manufacturers would be required to pay Medicare additional rebates for net drug prices exceeding the lowest international list price in a basket of 19 reference countries adjusted by gross domestic product per capita on purchasing power parity basis. In this study, we aimed to model the impact of the GLOBE and GUARD models for Medicare spending.
abstract.textZh: 美國的新藥價格是世界上最高的。Medicare和Medicaid服務中心發布了Medicare B部分（ GLOBE ）和D部分（ GUARD ）承保的處方藥的強制性最惠國付款模式。在這些付款模式下，製造商將被要求為超過19個參考國家（按購買力平價基礎按人均國內生產總值調整）的最低國際定價的淨藥品價格支付Medicare額外回扣。在這項研究中，我們的目標是模擬全球的影響，並保護醫療保險支出模式。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this cohort study of the GLOBE and GUARD payment models in US Medicare, we linked Medicare spending and prices with estimated current rebates, ex-manufacturer prices, and international sales data using Medicare data and commercial databases of sales and pricing from 19 model-specified reference countries (ie, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Czechia, Denmark, France, Germany, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Netherlands, Norway, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the UK) for all potential model-eligible brand-name drugs. The primary outcomes were estimated reductions in net Medicare spending under the GLOBE and GUARD payment models and median ratio of estimated reductions in Medicare spending to annual sales in the referenced country. In scenario analyses, we estimated changes in potential savings if the reference basket was narrowed to G7 countries and if manufacturers with separate agreements with the Department of Health and Human Services were exempt from model inclusion.
abstract.textZh: 在這項針對全球和美國聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)保護支付模式的隊列研究中，我們將聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)的支出和價格與目前的預估回饋金、前製造商價格和國際銷售數據聯繫起來，該數據使用聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)數據和來自19個特定型號參考國家（即澳大利亞、奧地利、比利時、加拿大、捷克、丹麥、法國、德國、愛爾蘭、以色列、意大利、日本、荷蘭、挪威、韓國、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士和英國）的銷售和定價的商業數據庫。 主要結果是全球醫療保險淨支出的估計減少，並保護支付模式以及參考國家醫療保險支出預計減少與年銷售額的中位數比率。 在情境分析中，我們估計，如果參考籃子縮小到G7國家，以及與衛生與公共服務部有單獨協議的製造商免於模型納入，則潛在節省的變化。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: The study included 195 brand-name drugs accounting for Medicare spending of US$87·9 billion. The estimated reductions in net Medicare spending were $5·2 billion (16·1%) under GLOBE and $6·4 billion (17·6%) under GUARD. In scenario analyses, potential savings would be reduced by 12·2% if the reference basket was narrowed to G7 countries and 71·3% if manufacturers with separate agreements were exempt from model participation. The median ratio of estimated reductions in Medicare net spending under GLOBE and GUARD to annual sales in the binding lowest referenced country was 3·8 (IQR 1·0-22·8). For 101 (73·2%) of 138 drugs, estimated reductions in Medicare spending would exceed annual sales in the binding referenced country.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Most-favoured-nation pricing for brand-name medicines in Medicare was projected to decrease net spending. Potential reductions in net Medicare spending would be substantially greater than sales in the reference countries, suggesting that shifts in manufacturer behaviour with model implementation could reduce possible savings.

articles.title: Wealth redistribution policies to mitigate the impact of development assistance defunding: a retrospective evaluation and forecasting analysis up to 2030
articles.authors: Sibils GB, Anderle RVR, da Silva AF, de Sales LOF, Pena D, Monti C, Vaz CG, Esposito L, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The ongoing decline in funding for humanitarian and development assistance stands in stark contrast to the global rise in wealth concentration and widening socioeconomic inequalities. This study aimed to assess whether the implementation of wealth redistribution policies-proposed in recent high-level international agreements to support development-could mitigate the health impact of the current official development assistance (ODA) defunding crisis.
abstract.textZh: 人道主義和發展援助的資金持續下降，與全球財富集中度上升和社會經濟不平等擴大形成鮮明對比。本研究旨在評估財富再分配政策的實施（在最近的高級別國際協議中提出以支持發展）是否可以減輕當前官方發展援助（ ODA ）撤資危機對健康的影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted an integrated retrospective impact evaluation and forecasting analysis using longitudinal panel data from 59 low-income and lower-middle-income countries. First, we estimated the association between per-capita ODA and mortality outcomes from 2002 to 2021 using two-way fixed-effects multivariable Poisson regression models with robust standard errors, adjusting for key demographic, socioeconomic, and health-system covariates. We did extensive sensitivity and triangulation analyses to assess the robustness and plausibility of the findings. We then evaluated ten wealth redistribution policies with validated country-level microsimulation models to forecast mortality outcomes under alternative wealth redistribution scenarios versus the current defunding scenario from 2026 to 2030.
abstract.textZh: 我們使用來自59個低收入和中低收入國家的縱向小組數據進行了綜合回溯性影響評估和預測分析。首先，我們使用具有強大標準誤差的雙向固定效應多變量泊鬆迴歸模型，調整關鍵人口統計、社會經濟和衛生系統協變量，估計了2002年至2021年人均ODA與死亡率結果之間的關聯。我們進行了廣泛的敏感性和三角分析，以評估結果的穩健性和合理性。然後，我們使用經過驗證的國家級微模擬模型評估了十種財富再分配政策，以預測替代財富再分配情景下的死亡率結果，以及2026年至2030年的當前去資金化情景。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: In comparison with the baseline ODA category, high ODA funding was associated with a 24% reduction in age-standardised all-cause mortality (rate ratio [RR] 0·76; 95% CI 0·67-0·87) and a 33% reduction in under-5 mortality (0·67; 0·50-0·89). Forecasting analyses showed that, in comparison with the current ODA funding reductions in the 59 selected low-income and lower-middle-income countries, all ten wealth redistribution policies were associated with millions of averted deaths by 2030: overall, the lowest number of averted deaths was 6 591 984 (95% uncertainty interval 4 884 075-8 374 138) for a 3% crypto tax applied to the top 10 000 holders, while the highest number of averted deaths was 29 509 934 (20 273 842-38 603 961) for a 3% wealth tax on ultra-high-net-worth individuals; in children younger than 5 years, the corresponding numbers of averted deaths were 1 312 912 (802 926-1 785 121) for a 3% crypto tax applied to the top 10 000 holders and 3 464 607 (1 235 930-5 609 331) for a 3% wealth tax on ultra-high-net-worth individuals.

abstract.text: The implementation of wealth redistribution policies proposed in recent high-level international agreements could mitigate the health consequences of the current ODA defunding crisis, avert millions of deaths, and support the achievement of the UN Sustainable Development Goals, particularly those related to health.

articles.title: Induction and consolidation atezolizumab with stereotactic body radiation therapy versus radiation alone in high-risk, early-stage non-small-cell lung cancer (SWOG/NRG S1914): a multicentre, open-label, superiority, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Daly ME, Simone CB, Redman MW, Hsieh MH, Hesketh PJ, Hu C, Monjazeb AM, Steuer CE, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) is the standard of care for early-stage, medically inoperable non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). We aimed to test the addition of neoadjuvant, concurrent, and adjuvant atezolizumab with SBRT for early-stage NSCLC.
abstract.textZh: 立體定向身體放射治療(SBRT)是早期、醫學上無法手術的非小細胞肺癌(NSCLC)的標準治療。我們的目標是測試新輔助藥物、同時藥物和輔助藥物atezolizumab加SBRT治療早期NSCLC。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial, eligible patients from 146 institutions across the USA who had T1-T3N0M0 NSCLC ≤7 cm, and were medically inoperable or declined surgery, and had at least one risk factor suggestive of increased risk of recurrence, were included in the study. Patients underwent open-label equal and stratified randomisation to SBRT over three to eight fractions with or without up to eight cycles of neoadjuvant, concurrent, and adjuvant atezolizumab 1200 mg intravenously every 21 days for up to eight cycles, with SBRT initiated with cycle three. The primary objective was to compare overall survival between the two groups. The group sequential design included four interim analyses. Target accrual was 480 patients (432 eligible). The trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04214262) and is closed to new participants.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心、開放標籤、3期、隨機對照試驗中，本研究納入了來自美國146個機構的合格患者，這些患者的T1-T3N0M0 NSCLC ≤ 7 cm ，且在醫學上無法手術或手術拒絕，並且至少有一個提示復發風險增加的風險因素。患者接受開放標籤相等和分層的隨機分組至SBRT超過三至八個分次，最多有或沒有八個週期的新輔助、同時和輔助阿特珠單抗1200 mg靜脈注射，每21天一次，最多八個週期， SBRT在第三個週期開始。主要目的是比較兩組之間的總生存期。羣組序列設計包括四項期中分析。目標累積為480名患者（ 432名符合資格）。該試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT04214262 ）註冊，並不對新參與者開放。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between March 25, 2020, and Sept 9, 2024, 417 patients were enrolled and randomly assigned to atezolizumab plus SBRT (n=210) or SBRT alone (n=207). 402 were eligible and made up the modified intention-to-treat population (201 per group). The median age was 72·8 years (IQR 67·4-78·4), 218 (54%) of 402 participants were female, and 184 (46%) were male. Accrual closed at the first interim analysis of all randomly assigned participants for futility with 76 progression-free survival (PFS) events and 41 deaths among 400 eligible participants (200 per group). An updated analysis was performed with 140 PFS events, 92 deaths, and a median of 24·8 months (range 0·1-64·9; IQR 18·6-36·0) of follow-up among living patients. The overall survival hazard ratio was 1·04 (95% CI 0·69-1·58; one-sided p=0·58). Estimated 2-year overall survival was 82% in both groups (95% CI 75-87). Grade 3 or higher adverse event rates were 12% with atezolizumab plus SBRT and 3% with SBRT. Two grade 5 respiratory events occurred in the atezolizumab plus SBRT group.
abstract.textZh: 在2020年3月25日至2024年9月9日期間，招募了417名患者，並將其隨機分配到atezolizumab加SBRT （ n = 210 ）或單獨SBRT （ n = 207 ）。402名患者符合資格，並構成了調整的意向治療人羣（每組201名）。 中位年齡為72 · 8歲（ IQR 67 · 4-78 · 4 ） ， 402名參與者中有218名（ 54 ％ ）為女性， 184名（ 46 ％ ）為男性。 累計結束於所有隨機分配參與者的第一次期中分析，無效，在400名合格參與者（每組200人）中發生了76例無惡化生存（ PFS ）事件和41例死亡。 對140例PFS事件、92例死亡和中位數為24 · 8個月（範圍0 · 1-64 · 9 ； IQR 18 · 6-36 · 0 ）的活患者進行了更新的分析。 整體生存風險比為1 · 04 （ 95% CI 0 · 69-1 · 58 ；單側p = 0 · 58 ）。 兩組的估計2年總生存率為82% （ 95% CI 75-87 ）。 使用atezolizumab加SBRT的3級或更高的不良事件發生率為12% ，使用SBRT的不良事件發生率為3%。 Atezolizumab + SBRT組中發生兩起5級呼吸事件。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In the first fully reported phase 3 cooperative group trial to assess immunotherapy in inoperable early-stage NSCLC, we observed no improvement in overall survival with atezolizumab plus SBRT, and more grade 3 or higher adverse events were reported with atezolizumab combined with SBRT.
abstract.textZh: 在第一次完全報告的評估無法手術的早期NSCLC免疫治療的3期合作羣組試驗中，我們觀察到使用atezolizumab加SBRT的總生存期沒有改善，並且使用atezolizumab加SBRT報告了更多3級或更高的不良事件。

articles.title: Physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in the emergency department (RESHAP-ED): a randomised controlled trial with economic evaluation
articles.authors: Sigera C, Campos TF, Coombs DM, Williams CM, Rogan E, Edwards J, Harris IA, Naganathan V, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Long stays in the emergency department compromise patient safety and health system performance. Physiotherapist-led models of care may improve care and emergency department performance, but their effects have not been rigorously evaluated in randomised trials. We compared the effectiveness, safety, and cost-effectiveness of physiotherapist-led care with usual care for patients presenting to the emergency department with musculoskeletal conditions.
abstract.textZh: 在急診室長期逗留會影響患者的安全和衛生系統的表現。物理治療師主導的護理模式可能會改善護理和急診科的績效，但其影響尚未在隨機試驗中進行嚴格評估。我們比較了物理治療師主導的護理與急診室肌肉骨骼疾病患者的常規護理的有效性、安全性和成本效益。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: RESHAP-ED was an open-label, pragmatic, randomised trial that recruited adults aged 18 years and older at five emergency departments in New South Wales, Australia, with uncomplicated musculoskeletal conditions (eg, soft tissue conditions, neck and back pain, and fractures or dislocations not requiring orthopaedic review or surgery). Participants were randomly assigned (1:1), using statistician-generated randomly permuted blocks, to either physiotherapist-led care (intervention) or usual physician-led or nurse practitioner-led care (control). The primary outcome was length of stay in the emergency department, calculated as time from arrival to discharge, analysed in the intention-to-treat population using a linear mixed-effects model. The trial was prospectively registered on the Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry (ACTRN12623000782639) and is completed.
abstract.textZh: RESHAP-ED是一項開放標籤、務實、隨機的試驗，在澳大利亞新南威爾士州的五個急診部門招募18歲及以上的成年人，他們患有不複雜的肌肉骨骼疾病（例如軟組織狀況、頸部和背部疼痛，以及不需要骨科檢查或手術的骨折或脫臼）。參與者使用統計學家產生的隨機排列區塊，被隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ）到物理治療師主導的護理（幹預）或通常的醫生主導或護理師主導的護理（對照）。主要結果是急診室的住院時間，以從抵達到出院的時間計算，使用線性混合效應模型在意向治療人羣中進行分析。該試驗已在澳大利亞新西蘭臨牀試驗註冊處（ ACTRN12623000782639 ）前瞻性註冊並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Nov 22, 2023 and March 29, 2025, 4219 patients were screened, 2728 were deemed ineligible for inclusion, and 1491 participants were randomly assigned (746 assigned to the physiotherapy-led intervention group and 745 assigned to the physician-led or nurse-led practitioner control group). Following the exclusion of 16 participants after randomisation, 1475 were included in the analysis (737 in the intervention group and 738 in the control group). The mean age of participants was 40·1 years (SD 16·5). 719 (48·7%) participants were male, 755 (51·2%) were female, and one (0·1%) participant had unreported sex data. Follow-up for the primary outcome was 100% complete. The mean length of stay in the emergency department was 2·4 h in the intervention group and 3·4 h in the control group (-1·0 h [95% CI -1·2 to -0·8]). Adverse events were reported by 39 (6·6%) of 591 participants in the intervention group versus 33 (5·9%) of 555 in the control group (p=0·72). The intervention group had lower costs (-$35·1 [95% CI -69·0 to -1·7]) and a high probability (98·1%) of being cost-effective.
abstract.textZh: 在2023年11月22日至2025年3月29日期間，篩選了4219名患者， 2728名被認為不符合入組資格，並隨機分配了1491名參與者（ 746名分配到物理治療主導的幹預組， 745名分配到醫生主導或護士主導的從業者對照組）。 隨機分組後排除16名參與者後， 1475人被納入分析（幹預組737人，對照組738人）。 參與者的平均年齡為40 · 1歲（ SD 16 · 5 ）。719名（ 48 · 7 ％ ）參與者為男性， 755名（ 51 · 2 ％ ）為女性， 1名（ 0 · 1 ％ ）參與者有未報告的性別數據。 主要結果的追蹤100%完成。 急診科平均住院時間介入組為2 · 4小時，對照組為3 · 4小時（ -1 · 0小時[95% CI -1 · 2至-0 · 8] ）。 介入組中591名參與者中有39名（ 6.6 ％ ）報告了不良事件，而對照組中555名參與者中有33名（ 5.9 ％ ）報告了不良事件（ p = 0.72 ）。 幹預組具有較低的成本（ - $ 35 · 1 [95 ％ CI -69 · 0至-1 · 7] ）和具有成本效益的高概率（ 98 · 1% ）。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: A physiotherapist-led model of care in the emergency department reduced length of stay among patients presenting with uncomplicated musculoskeletal conditions, without compromising health outcomes or safety, and was cost-effective.

articles.title: Survodutide Once Weekly in Adults with Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes
articles.authors: Wharton S, le Roux CW, Startseva E, Kloer IM, Alhussein A, Hussain SA, Unseld A, Bozkurt B, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: For persons living with both type 2 diabetes and obesity, weight management may be the most effective therapy for type 2 diabetes. Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists have potent weight-reducing effects, and other mechanisms may confer additional benefits. Survodutide is an investigational glucagon receptor-GLP-1 receptor dual agonist with potential weight-reducing and metabolic benefits.
abstract.textZh: 對於2型糖尿病和肥胖症患者，體重管理可能是2型糖尿病最有效的治療方法。胰高血糖素樣肽-1 （ GLP-1 ）受體激動劑具有強大的減肥作用，其他機制可能會帶來額外的益處。Survodutide是一種研究性胰高血糖素受體-GLP-1受體雙重激動劑，具有潛在的減肥和代謝益處。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multinational, double-blind, phase 3 trial involving adults with type 2 diabetes and a body-mass index (BMI; the weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height in meters) of 27 or more, we randomly assigned participants in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive once-weekly subcutaneous survodutide (3.6 mg or 6.0 mg) or placebo. The two primary end points were the percent change in body weight and a reduction in body weight of at least 5% from baseline to week 76.
abstract.textZh: 在這項涉及患有2型糖尿病且體重指數（ BMI ；體重以公斤除以身高平方米為單位）為27或以上的成人進行的多國雙盲3期試驗中，我們以1: 1: 1的比例隨機分配參與者接受每週一次的皮下survodutide （ 3.6毫克或6.0毫克）或安慰劑。兩個主要終點是從基線到第76週的體重變化百分比和體重減少至少5%。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 752 participants (250 in the 3.6-mg survodutide group, 251 in the 6.0-mg survodutide group, and 251 in the placebo group), the mean age at baseline was 55.7 years, and the mean BMI was 36.5; 49.3% were men. The mean weight change at week 76 according to the treatment-regimen estimand (which assessed effects regardless of whether the trial regimen was discontinued or interrupted or whether other antiobesity therapies were used) was -8.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], -9.2 to -7.2) in the 3.6-mg group, -9.8% (95% CI, -10.8 to -8.8) in the 6.0-mg group, and -3.9% (95% CI, -4.9 to -2.9) in the placebo group; weight reduction of at least 5% occurred in 57.6%, 64.5%, and 35.1% of the participants, respectively (P<0.001 for all comparisons with placebo). The mean change in the glycated hemoglobin level (from a baseline level of 7.4%) was -0.9 percentage points in the 3.6-mg group, -0.8 percentage points in the 6.0-mg group, and -0.2 percentage points in the placebo group. The most common adverse events were gastrointestinal (generally mild to moderate and transient), which occurred in 182 participants (72.8%) in the 3.6-mg group, 195 (77.7%) in the 6.0-mg group, and 97 (38.6%) in the placebo group.
abstract.textZh: 在752名參與者（ 3.6-mg survodutide組250名、6.0-mg survodutide組251名、安慰劑組251名）中，基線時的平均年齡為55.7歲，平均BMI為36.5 ； 49.3%為男性。 根據治療方案的估計數據（無論試驗方案是否中斷或是否使用其他抗肥胖療法，評估療效） ，第76週的平均體重變化在3.6-mg組中為-8.2% （ 95%置信區間[CI] ， -9.2至-7.2 ） ，在6.0-mg組中為-9.8% （ 95% CI ， -10.8至-8.8 ） ，在安慰劑組中為-3.9% （ 95% CI ， -4.9至-2.9 ） ； 57.6%、64.5%和35.1%的參與者體重減輕至少5% （與安慰劑的所有比較為P < 0.001 ）。 糖化血紅蛋白水平的平均變化（基線水平為7.4% ）在3.6毫克組中為-0.9個百分點，在6.0毫克組中為-0.8個百分點，在安慰劑組中為-0.2個百分點。 最常見的不良事件是胃腸道（一般為輕度至中度和短暫） ，發生在3.6毫克組的182名參與者（ 72.8 ％ ）、6.0毫克組的195名參與者（ 77.7 ％ ）和安慰劑組的97名參與者（ 38.6 ％ ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes, survodutide at a weekly dose of 3.6 mg or 6.0 mg resulted in significantly greater weight reduction than placebo. (Funded by Boehringer Ingelheim; SYNCHRONIZE-2 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06066528.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有肥胖症和2型糖尿病的成年人中，每週劑量為3.6 mg或6.0 mg的survodutide比安慰劑導致顯著更大的體重減輕。（由勃林格殷格翰資助； SYNCHRONIZE-2 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06066528 ）。

articles.title: Giredestrant plus Everolimus in Advanced Breast Cancer
articles.authors: Mayer EL, Tolaney SM, Martín M, Vidal GA, Moscetti L, Jhaveri KL, Brufsky A, Gradishar WJ, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Giredestrant and everolimus target the estrogen receptor (ER) pathway and the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K)-protein kinase B (AKT)-mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway, respectively, which are implicated in endocrine-therapy resistance.
abstract.textZh: Giredestrant和依維莫司分別靶向雌激素受體（ ER ）通路和磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（ PI3K ） -蛋白激酶B （ AKT ） -雷帕黴素（ mTOR ）通路的哺乳動物靶標，這與內分泌治療耐藥性有關。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, open-label, randomized trial, we enrolled patients with ER-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer who had disease progression or recurrence after receipt of a cyclin-dependent kinase 4 and 6 (CDK4/6) inhibitor plus endocrine therapy. Patients were assigned, in a 1:1 ratio, to receive giredestrant plus everolimus (each given orally) or standard endocrine therapy (i.e., exemestane, fulvestrant, or tamoxifen) plus everolimus. The primary end point was investigator-assessed progression-free survival, evaluated first among patients with ESR1-mutated tumors and then in the overall trial population.
abstract.textZh: 在這項3期開放標籤隨機試驗中，我們招募了ER陽性、人表皮生長因子受體2 (HER2)陰性的局部晚期或轉移性乳腺癌患者，這些患者在接受細胞週期蛋白依賴性激酶4和6 (CDK4/6)抑制劑加上內分泌治療後出現疾病進展或復發。患者以1: 1的比例被分配接受giredestrant加依維莫司（每次口服）或標準內分泌治療（即依西美坦、氟維司羣或他莫昔芬）加依維莫司。主要終點是研究者評估的無惡化生存期，首先在患有ESR1突變腫瘤的患者中進行評估，然後在整體試驗族羣中進行評估。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Overall, 373 patients underwent randomization, with 183 assigned to the giredestrant-everolimus group and 190 to the standard therapy-everolimus group. Among 207 patients with ESR1-mutated tumors, the median progression-free survival was 10.0 months with giredestrant-everolimus and 5.5 months with standard therapy-everolimus (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.38; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.27 to 0.54; P<0.001). In the overall population, the median progression-free survival was 8.8 months with giredestrant-everolimus and 5.5 months with standard therapy-everolimus (hazard ratio, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.44 to 0.71; P<0.001). Adverse events occurred in 98.9% of patients who received giredestrant-everolimus and in 96.8% of those who received standard therapy-everolimus. The most common adverse events were stomatitis (in 47.3% of giredestrant-everolimus recipients and 48.9% of standard therapy-everolimus recipients), diarrhea (in 26.9% and 22.6%, respectively), and anemia (in 23.6% and 21.0%).
abstract.textZh: 總體而言， 373名患者接受了隨機分組，其中183名分配到giredestrant-everolimus組， 190名分配到標準治療-everolimus組。 在207名ESR1突變腫瘤患者中， giredestrant-everolimus的中位無惡化生存期為10.0個月，標準治療-everolimus為5.5個月（疾病惡化或死亡的風險比， 0.38 ； 95%可信區間[CI] ， 0.27至0.54 ； P < 0.001 ）。 在整體族羣中， giredestrant-everolimus的中位無惡化生存期為8.8個月，標準治療-everolimus為5.5個月（風險比， 0.56 ； 95% CI ， 0.44至0.71 ； P < 0.001 ）。 98.9%接受giredestrant-everolimus的患者和96.8%接受標準治療的患者發生不良事件。 最常見的不良事件是口腔炎（ 47.3 ％的giredestrant-everolimus接受者和48.9 ％的標準治療-everolimus接受者）、腹瀉（分別為26.9 ％和22.6 ％ ）和貧血（ 23.6 ％和21.0 ％ ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: An all-oral giredestrant-everolimus regimen led to significantly longer progression-free survival than standard endocrine therapy-everolimus among patients with ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer who had received a CDK4/6 inhibitor previously, mainly in patients with ESR1-mutated tumors. The incidence of adverse events was similar in the two groups. (Funded by Genentech; evERA Breast Cancer ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05306340.).
abstract.textZh: 在先前接受過CDK4/6抑制劑的ER陽性、HER2陰性晚期乳腺癌患者中，全口服giredestrant-everolimus方案導致無惡化生存期明顯長於標準內分泌治療-everolimus ，主要是在ESR1突變腫瘤患者中。兩組不良事件發生率相似。（由Genentech資助； evERA Breast Cancer ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05306340。）。

articles.title: Atorvastatin, Cardiovascular Events, and Disability-free Survival in Older Adults
articles.authors: Zoungas S, Wolfe R, Moran C, Nicholls SJ, Cloud GC, Reid CM, Τonkin AM, Beilin L, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The effectiveness and safety of statins for the primary prevention of cardiovascular events and the extension of disability-free survival among older adults remain uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 他汀類藥物在一級預防心血管事件和延長老年人無殘疾生存期方面的有效性和安全性仍然不確定。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial at general medical practices across Australia. Community-dwelling adults at least 70 years of age with no history of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive atorvastatin at a dose of 40 mg once daily or identical placebo. The two primary end points were a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction or stroke, or coronary revascularization (to assess effects on major cardiovascular events) and a composite of death from any cause, dementia, or persistent physical disability (to assess effects on disability-free survival). Analyses were performed according to a hierarchical testing plan.
abstract.textZh: 我們在澳大利亞各地的一般醫療實踐中進行了一項雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照試驗。以1: 1的比例隨機分配至少70歲且無心血管疾病、糖尿病或失智症病史的社區成人接受阿託伐他汀，劑量為40毫克，每日一次或相同的安慰劑。兩個主要終點是心血管原因死亡、非致命性心肌梗塞或中風或冠狀動脈血運重建（評估對主要心血管事件的影響）的綜合評估，以及任何原因死亡、失智症或持續性身體殘疾（評估對無殘疾生存的影響）的綜合評估。根據分層測試計劃進行分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 9971 participants were enrolled: 4984 were assigned to receive atorvastatin and 4987 to receive placebo. The mean (±SD) age of the participants was 74.7±4.5 years, and 51.9% were women. After a median of 5.9 years, a primary cardiovascular event had occurred in 297 participants (10.9 events per 1000 person-years) in the atorvastatin group and in 412 participants (15.5 events per 1000 person-years) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.70; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.61 to 0.82; P<0.001). Death from any cause, dementia, or persistent physical disability occurred in 637 participants (21.6 events per 1000 person-years) in the atorvastatin group and in 676 participants (23.0 events per 1000 person-years) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.84 to 1.05; P = 0.25). Serious adverse events occurred in 131 participants (2.7%) in the atorvastatin group and in 129 (2.7%) in the placebo group, with musculoskeletal, hepatobiliary, and diabetes-related adverse events occurring more commonly in the atorvastatin group.
abstract.textZh: 總共招募了9971名參與者： 4984名被分配接受阿託伐他汀， 4987名接受安慰劑。 參與者的平均(± SD)年齡為74.7 ± 4.5歲， 51.9%為女性。 在中位數5.9年後，阿託伐他汀組的297名參與者（每1000人年10.9次事件）和安慰劑組的412名參與者（每1000人年15.5次事件）發生了原發性心血管事件（風險比， 0.70 ； 95%置信區間[CI] ， 0.61至0.82 ； P < 0.001 ）。 阿託伐他汀組的637名參與者（每1000人年21.6次事件）和安慰劑組的676名參與者（每1000人年23.0次事件）發生任何原因、失智症或持續性身體殘疾死亡（風險比， 0.94 ； 95% CI ， 0.84至1.05 ； P = 0.25 ）。 阿託伐他汀組131名受試者（ 2.7% ）和安慰劑組129名受試者（ 2.7% ）發生嚴重不良事件，阿託伐他汀組更常發生肌肉骨骼、肝膽和糖尿病相關不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Treatment with atorvastatin led to a lower risk of major cardiovascular events than placebo at a median of 5.9 years but did not result in longer disability-free survival among community-dwelling older adults without clinical cardiovascular disease. (Funded by the National Health and Medical Research Council and others; STAREE ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT02099123.).
abstract.textZh: 與安慰劑相比，阿託伐他汀治療導致主要心血管事件的風險較低，中位數為5.9年，但在沒有臨牀心血管疾病的社區居住老年人中並未導致更長的無殘疾生存期。（由國家衛生和醫學研究委員會及其他機構資助； STAREE ClinicalTrials.gov編號： NCT02099123 ）。

articles.titleZh: 阿託伐他汀、心血管事件和老年人的無殘疾生存期

articles.title: Phase 3 Trial of Weekly Oral Islatravir-Lenacapavir for HIV-1 Treatment
articles.authors: Rockstroh JK, Ramgopal MN, Curran Fàbregas A, Hedgcock M, Workowski KA, Ronot-Bregigeon S, Cassetti I, Brinson C, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Once-daily, single-tablet regimens have transformed care for persons living with human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1); however, challenges to adherence continue to limit effective treatment. Long-acting oral-drug combinations could offer new options with less frequent dose administration.
abstract.textZh: 每天一次的單片療法改變了對1型人類免疫缺陷病毒（ HIV-1 ）患者的護理；然而，依從性的挑戰繼續限制有效的治療。長效口服藥物組合可以提供劑量較少的新選擇。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a phase 3, double-blind, randomized, active-controlled, noninferiority trial in 12 countries to evaluate the efficacy and safety of a switch to once-weekly oral islatravir-lenacapavir (ISL/LEN) from once-daily oral bictegravir-emtricitabine-tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in adults in whom HIV-1 had been virologically suppressed for at least 6 months while they were receiving B/F/TAF. Participants were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive once-weekly ISL/LEN (2 mg/300 mg) or to continue once-daily B/F/TAF for 96 weeks; all received matched placebo for the alternative regimen. The primary end point was the percentage of participants with an HIV-1 RNA level of 50 copies per milliliter or higher at week 48, as determined by the Food and Drug Administration-defined snapshot algorithm. Noninferiority was determined at a margin of 4 percentage points.
abstract.textZh: 我們在12個國家進行了一項3期、雙盲、隨機、活性對照、非劣效性試驗，以評估在接受B/F/TAF期間HIV-1病毒學抑制至少6個月的成年人中，從每日一次的口服bictegravir-emtricitabine-tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF)改用每週一次的口服islatravir-lenacapavir (ISL/LEN)的療效和安全性。以1: 1的比例分配參與者接受每週一次的ISL/LEN (2 mg/300 mg)或繼續每日一次的B/F/TAF ，持續96週；所有參與者均接受替代方案的匹配安慰劑。主要終點是美國食品和藥物管理局定義的快照演算法確定的第48週時， HIV-1 RNA水平為每毫升50拷貝或更高的參與者百分比。非劣效性以4個百分點的邊際值確定。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 607 participants underwent randomization; 304 were assigned to the ISL/LEN group and 303 to the B/F/TAF group. A total of 21% of the participants were women, 31% were Black, 26% were Hispanic or Latine, and 15% were 65 years of age or older. At week 48, an HIV-1 RNA level of 50 copies per milliliter or higher was reported in no participants in the ISL/LEN group and 1 (0.3%) in the B/F/TAF group (difference, -0.3 percentage points; 95.002% confidence interval [CI], -1.4 to 0.8); an HIV-1 RNA level of less than 50 copies per milliliter was reported in 284 (93.4%) and 280 (92.4%), respectively (difference, 1.0 percentage point, 95% CI, -3.2 to 5.2). The mean change in the CD4+ T-cell count at week 48 was -10 cells per microliter with ISL/LEN and -18 cells per microliter with B/F/TAF (least-squares mean difference, 12 cells per microliter; 95% CI, -16 to 39). The trial regimen was discontinued owing to adverse events in 6 participants (2.0%) in the ISL/LEN group and 5 (1.7%) in the B/F/TAF group; serious adverse events occurred in 16 (5.3%) and 14 (4.6%), respectively.
abstract.textZh: 共有607名參與者接受了隨機分組； 304名被分配到ISL/LEN組， 303名被分配到B/F/TAF組。 共有21%的參與者是女性， 31%是黑人， 26%是西班牙裔或拉丁裔， 15%是65歲或以上。 在第48週，在ISL/LEN組中沒有參與者報告HIV-1 RNA水平為每毫升50拷貝或更高，在B/F/TAF組中報告HIV-1 RNA水平為1 (0.3%) (差異， -0.3個百分點； 95.002%置信區間[CI] ， -1.4至0.8) ；在284 (93.4%)和280 (92.4%)中報告HIV-1 RNA水平分別低於每毫升50拷貝(差異， 1.0個百分點， 95% CI ， -3.2至5.2)。 第48週時CD4 + T細胞計數的平均變化是：使用ISL/LEN時每微升-10個細胞，使用B/F/TAF時每微升-18個細胞(最小二乘平均差，每微升12個細胞； 95% CI ， -16至39)。 由於ISL/LEN組6名參與者（ 2.0 ％ ）和B/F/TAF組5名（ 1.7 ％ ）的不良事件，試驗方案停止；嚴重不良事件分別發生在16名（ 5.3 ％ ）和14名（ 4.6 ％ ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among persons with virologically suppressed HIV-1, once-weekly oral ISL/LEN was noninferior to once-daily B/F/TAF in maintaining HIV viral load suppression. (Funded by Gilead Sciences and Merck Sharp and Dohme; ISLEND-1 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06630286.).
abstract.textZh: 在病毒學抑制的HIV-1患者中，每週一次的口服ISL/LEN在維持HIV病毒載量抑制方面不劣於每日一次的B/F/TAF。（由Gilead Sciences和Merck Sharp and Dohme資助； ISLEND-1 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06630286。）

articles.title: Andes Virus - A Clinical Review
articles.authors: Harris GH, Sinchi A, Lawler J, Frank M

abstract.text: Andes virus (ANDV) is the sole orthohantavirus with documented human-to-human transmission. We summarize the epidemiology and clinical features of ANDV infection and review best practices in clinical management, as based on published expert consensus guidelines, field experience, and clinical trials. We also evaluate currently available and investigational treatments (including the use of antiviral agents), assess emerging monoclonal antibody therapies, and outline prospects for vaccine development. Finally, we discuss important infection prevention and control measures.
abstract.textZh: 安第斯病毒（ ANDV ）是唯一有記錄的人傳人傳播的骨幹病毒。我們根據已發表的專家共識指南、現場經驗和臨牀試驗，總結ANDV感染的流行病學和臨牀特徵，並回顧臨牀管理的最佳實踐。我們還評估目前可用的治療和研究治療（包括使用抗病毒藥物） ，評估新興的單株抗體療法，並概述疫苗開發的前景。最後，我們討論了重要的感染預防和控制措施。

articles.title: Clinical empathy and relational continuity mitigate care fragmentation for patients with multiple long-term conditions: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Arakelyan S, Guthrie B, Anand A, Lone N, Mercer SW, Tooman T

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Services for patients with multiple long-term conditions (MLTC) operate within fragmented and poorly coordinated systems but how care experiences, perceptions, and behaviours emerge and adapt in response to service changes and increasing system complexity is poorly understood.
abstract.textZh: 為患有多種長期病症（ MLTC ）的患者提供的服務在支離破碎且協調不佳的系統中運作，但人們對護理體驗、觀念和行為如何因應服務變化和系統複雜性增加而產生和適應知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore how experiences and perceptions of care for patients with MLTC and their carers emerge and evolve within a complex adaptive care system to identify opportunities for better care.
abstract.textZh: 探索MLTC患者及其護理人員的護理經驗和觀念如何在複雜的適應性護理系統中出現和發展，以確定更好的護理機會。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative analysis of six focus groups with 28 patients with MLTC and carers in four Scottish integrated health and social care partnerships was undertaken.
abstract.textZh: 對四個蘇格蘭綜合健康和社會護理合作夥伴關係中的六個焦點小組（包括28名MLTC患者和護理人員）進行了定性分析。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data were collected between February and May 2024. Abductive analysis informed by a complex adaptive systems lens was used.
abstract.textZh: 資料收集於2024年2月至5月之間。使用由複雜自適應系統晶狀體提供的外展分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Care for patients with MLTC emerged through dynamic, reciprocal interactions between patients, carers, professionals, and organisational structures. Service changes introduced to manage rising demand were often perceived as misaligned with patients' complex needs, prompting patients and carers to modify their behaviours to navigate access barriers. Care experiences were unpredictable, shaped by reinforcing feedback loops in which small personal interactions had a disproportionate effect on trust and engagement. Informal care expanded to fill system gaps, with family members assuming coordination and advocacy roles. Clinical empathy and relational continuity of care acted as key stabilising influences within fragmented care systems.
abstract.textZh: 對MLTC患者的護理透過患者、護理人員、專業人員和組織結構之間的動態、互惠互動而出現。為管理不斷增長的需求而引入的服務變更通常被認為與患者的複雜需求不符，促使患者和護理人員修改其行為以克服出入障礙。照護體驗是不可預測的，由強化的反饋迴路形成，其中小的個人互動對信任和參與度產生不成比例的影響。非正式護理擴大到填補系統空白，由家庭成員擔任協調和倡導角色。臨牀同理心和護理的關係連續性在支離破碎的護理系統中起著關鍵的穩定影響作用。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Service changes intended to improve care efficiency can inadvertently destabilise care and shift the burden onto patients with MLTC and their carers, affecting perceived care quality and relational continuity. The quality of interactions and relationships between agents shape patients' perceptions of care and future engagement.
abstract.textZh: 旨在提高護理效率的服務變化可能會無意中破壞護理，並將負擔轉嫁給MLTC患者及其護理人員，影響感知護理質量和關係連續性。客服人員之間的互動和關係的品質會影響患者對照護和未來參與的看法。

articles.titleZh: 臨牀同理心和關係連續性減輕多重長期病症患者的護理碎片：定性研究

articles.title: Cost savings from primary care clinic continuity among patients with chronic disease in Alberta, Canada: a retrospective population-level cross-sectional study
articles.authors: McDonald T, Lethebe BC, Green LA

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Continuity of care with a primary care physician (PCP) is well known to improve patient health, result in less health service utilisation (HSU), and lower costs. Less is known about the impact of clinic continuity related to team-based care and shared practice models. Information on the cost impact of such models is needed to guide design and payment policies.
abstract.textZh: 眾所周知，初級護理醫生（ PCP ）的持續護理可以改善患者健康，減少醫療服務利用率（ HSU ）並降低成本。與團隊式照護和共享實踐模式相關的診所連續性的影響知之甚少。需要有關此類模式的成本影響的資訊，以指導設計和付款政策。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To estimate savings in HSU costs for patients with chronic disease when they are moved from primary care clinics with low and moderate continuity levels to those with high levels.
abstract.textZh: 估計慢性病患者從低和中等連續性水平的初級保健診所轉移到高水平的診所時， HSU成本的節省。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A 3-year retrospective population based cross-sectional study examined the HSU costs associated with three levels of primary care clinic continuity for approximately 70 000 matched patients from a cohort of 500 000 patients with chronic disease in Alberta, Canada. All fee-for-service PCPs were included.
abstract.textZh: 一項為期3年的回溯性人羣橫斷面研究檢查了加拿大亞伯達省500,000名慢性病患者隊列中約70,000名匹配患者與三級初級保健診所連續性相關的HSU成本。所有收費的五氯苯酚都包括在內。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Clinic continuity was calculated by adapting the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index. Costs were estimated using costing methodologies from the Canadian Institute of Health Information.
abstract.textZh: 診所連續性是通過調整常規護理提供者（ UPC ）指數來計算的。使用加拿大健康信息研究所的成本估算方法估算成本。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The association between continuity and acute care costs suggests achieving high clinic continuity (UPC 80-100%) for all 195 000 patients in less than high clinic continuity care could theoretically yield upwards of £898 million over 3 years. Estimated per-patient gains were highest among the most medically complex patients.
abstract.textZh: 連續性與急性照護成本之間的關聯表明，在低於高診所連續性照護的所有195,000名患者中實現高診所連續性（ UPC 80-100 ％ ）理論上可以在3年內產生高達8.98億£的收益。在醫學上最複雜的患者中，每位患者的預估增益最高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Cost savings were associated with clinic continuity among patients with common chronic diseases at all levels of complexity. Significant cost savings could be realised by focusing patient care on primary care clinics that favour high levels of continuity.
abstract.textZh: 在所有複雜程度的常見慢性疾病患者中，成本節省與診所的連續性有關。通過將患者護理專注於有利於高度連續性的初級護理診所，可以實現顯著的成本節省。

articles.titleZh: 加拿大亞伯達省慢性病患者初級保健診所連續性節省的成本：一項回顧性人羣水平橫斷面研究

articles.title: Sustaining named GP continuity requires organisational change: a comparative implementation analysis in Finland
articles.authors: Tuompo W, Mäkelä J, Timonen M, Auvinen J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maintaining doctor-patient relationship continuity remains a challenge in public primary care in Finland and internationally owing to GP workforce pressures and organisational constraints.
abstract.textZh: 由於全科醫生的勞動力壓力和組織限制，維持醫患關係的連續性仍然是芬蘭和國際公共初級保健的挑戰。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate implementation of a named GP model and explain differences in implementation outcomes between two Finnish primary care units.
abstract.textZh: 評估指定的全科醫生模式的實施情況，並解釋芬蘭兩個初級保健單位之間實施結果的差異。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A quasi-experimental before-after study was conducted in two Finnish primary care units with contrasting organisational settings. Patients were assigned a named GP responsible for non-urgent care. Electronic health record data covering physician consultations over 48 months were analysed.
abstract.textZh: 在兩個芬蘭初級保健單位中進行了準實驗性事前事後研究，組織環境形成對比。患者被指派負責非緊急護理的指定全科醫生。分析了涵蓋48個月內醫師會診的電子健康記錄數據。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Continuity was measured using the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index, the St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC), and the Own Patient Ratio (OPR). Implementation outcomes were interpreted using the RE-AIM framework. A segmented interrupted time series model was applied to OPR and SLICC, and UPC analysed using a pre-post design.
abstract.textZh: 使用普通護理提供者（ UPC ）指數、聖倫納德護理持續性指數（ SLICC ）和自身患者比率（ OPR ）來測量連續性。實施結果使用RE-AIM框架來解釋。將分段中斷時間序列模型應用於OPR和SLICC ，並使用前後設計分析UPC。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Named GP continuity was higher in Tuira than in Pudasjärvi across all measures. In Tuira, adoption (OPR 0.88) was high and stable with lower named GP-level variation, while reach (SLICC 0.31) and effectiveness (UPC 0.35) improved but remained modest. Although continuity improved in Pudasjärvi, adoption remained weaker (OPR 0.40), reach lower (SLICC 0.16), and maintenance less stable. Continuity of care with physicians other than the named GP increased more in Pudasjärvi.
abstract.textZh: 在所有措施中， Tuira的命名GP連續性都高於Pudasjärvi。在圖伊拉，採用率（ OPR 0.88 ）高且穩定， GP水平變化較低，而REACH （ SLICC 0.31 ）和有效性（ UPC 0.35 ）有所改善，但仍然適度。雖然Pudasjärvi的連續性有所改善，但採用率仍然較弱（ OPR 0.40 ） ，達到較低（ SLICC 0.16 ） ，維護不太穩定。在Pudasjärvi ，除了指定的全科醫生之外，其他醫生的持續護理增加更多。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The named GP model was functionally adopted in Tuira but remained largely nominal in Pudasjärvi. Health systems implementing named GP models should prioritise sustained GP presence and organisational alignment to achieve continuity.
abstract.textZh: 命名的GP模型在Tuira功能上採用，但在Pudasjärvi基本上保持名義。實施指定GP模型的衛生系統應優先考慮持續的GP存在和組織一致性，以實現連續性。

articles.titleZh: 維持指定的全科醫生連續性需要組織變革：芬蘭的比較實施分析

articles.title: Diagnostic models for male lower urinary tract symptom management in primary care: a prospective, multicentre, diagnostic accuracy study
articles.authors: Harding C, Agarwal R, Bates J, Bray A, Milosevic S, Thomas-Jones E, Drinnan M, Drake M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Recent research has concluded that primary care assessment and management of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) requires practical resources.
abstract.textZh: 最近的研究得出結論，初級保健評估和下尿路症狀（ LUTS ）的管理需要實用的資源。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To develop and independently validate risk-prediction models for three common urological conditions based on a combination of simple, minimally invasive index tests in men with LUTS presenting to primary care.
abstract.textZh: 基於對接受初級保健的LUTS男性進行簡單的微創指數測試的組合，開發並獨立驗證三種常見泌尿系統疾病的風險預測模型。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A prospective, multicentre, diagnostic accuracy study with independent development and validation cohorts set in 67 general practices in England and Wales.
abstract.textZh: 一項前瞻性、多中心、診斷準確性研究，在英格蘭和威爾斯的67個一般實踐中設置了獨立的開發和驗證隊列。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A total of 601 men presenting to primary care with LUTS, 350 in the development cohort and 251 in the validation cohort, underwent index tests - validated symptom assessment, bladder diary, physical examination, serum prostate specific antigen, uroflowmetry, and post-void residual volume estimation. Invasive urodynamic studies provided a diagnostic reference standard. Risk-prediction models for urodynamic diagnoses were developed and then validated in independent cohorts. Discriminative and calibration performance of the risk-prediction models for diagnosing bladder outlet obstruction (BOO), detrusor underactivity (DU), and detrusor overactivity (DO) using the c-index, calibration slope and plot, and sensitivity and specificity of the models was undertaken.
abstract.textZh: 共有601名接受LUTS初級保健的男性， 350名在發展隊列中， 251名在驗證隊列中，接受了指數測試-驗證症狀評估、膀胱日記、體格檢查、血清前列腺特異性抗原、尿流量測定和排尿後剩餘體積估計。侵入性尿動力學研究提供了診斷參考標準。開發了尿動力學診斷的風險預測模型，然後在獨立隊列中進行驗證。使用c指數、校準斜率和繪圖來診斷膀胱出口阻塞（ BOO ）、逼尿肌活動不足（ DU ）和逼尿肌活動過度（ DO ）的風險預測模型的判別和校準性能，以及模型的靈敏度和特異性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The BOO model from the development cohort demonstrated good discriminative performance (optimism-corrected c-index of 0.80). The models derived from the development cohort for DU and DO demonstrated moderate discriminative ability (optimism-corrected c-indices of 0.64 and 0.67, respectively). Similar estimates of c-index were observed for each model within the independent validation cohort (BOO, 0.82; DU, 0.63; and DO, 0.62).
abstract.textZh: 來自發展隊列的BOO模型顯示出良好的辨別表現（樂觀糾正的c指數為0.80 ）。來自DU和DO發展隊列的模型顯示出中度辨別能力（樂觀糾正的c指數分別為0.64和0.67 ）。在獨立驗證隊列中的每個模型中觀察到相似的c指數估計值（ BOO ， 0.82 ； DU ， 0.63 ；和DO ， 0.62 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Using a combination of simple, non-invasive index tests can accurately predict common urological diagnoses in men with LUTS, potentially facilitating earlier initiation of evidence-based treatments and improved management in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 使用簡單、非侵入性指數測試的組合可以準確預測LUTS患者的常見泌尿系統診斷，可能有助於及早開始循證治療並改善初級保健的管理。

articles.titleZh: 初級保健中男性下尿路症狀管理的診斷模型：一項前瞻性、多中心、診斷準確性研究

articles.title: Primary care practitioners' experiences managing urinary tract infections: a qualitative evidence synthesis
articles.authors: Kleuser H, Toye F, Kannapin F, Ghirotto L, Parisi S, Serafini A, Bassi MC, Gágyor I, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are common in primary care. Qualitative studies suggest that the way primary care practitioners (PCPs) manage UTIs may be influenced by a complex interplay of factors.
abstract.textZh: 尿路感染（ UTI ）在初級保健中很常見。定性研究表明，初級保健從業者（ PCP ）管理泌尿道感染的方式可能受到複雜因素相互作用的影響。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore the views, perceptions, and experiences of PCPs in the management of UTIs.
abstract.textZh: 探索PCP在UTI管理中的觀點、看法和經驗。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative evidence synthesis of studies set in general practice internationally.
abstract.textZh: 國際一般實踐研究的定性證據綜合。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Four databases were systematically searched from inception to 28 June 2024, and forward citation searching of included studies was undertaken. Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis was used to synthesise findings and the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP) checklist was applied to assess the quality of studies.
abstract.textZh: 從開始到2024年6月28日，系統地搜索了四個數據庫，並對納入的研究進行了正向引文搜索。使用Braun和Clarke的反思性主題分析來綜合結果，並應用批判性評估技能計劃（ CASP ）檢查清單來評估研究的質量。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In total, 3956 records were identified and 190 publications reviewed in full. Thirty-two qualitative studies reporting on 677 PCPs were included, generating the following themes: 1) I am confident; 2) … until patient X presents; 3) I am a victim of an overstretched healthcare system; 4) I must weigh up the benefits and impact of antibiotic treatment; and 5) it all comes down to our relationship. Using the CASP checklist, the quality of research was rated as high.
abstract.textZh: 總共確定了3956份記錄，並對190份出版物進行了全面審查。納入了報告677個PCP的32項定性研究，產生了以下主題： 1 ）我有信心; 2 ）......直到患者X出現; 3 ）我是醫療保健系統過度緊張的受害者; 4 ）我必須權衡抗生素治療的好處和影響; 5 ）這一切都歸結於我們的關係。使用CASP檢查清單，研究質量被評為高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: PCPs felt confident in managing UTIs, but uncertainty arose when patient X (children, men, older patients, those with recurrent UTIs) presented and PCPs perceived consultations as more complex. This analysis highlights the persistent and complex clinical challenge of assessing the risks and benefits of prescribing antibiotics. Chronic underfunding, staff shortages, and conflicting provider-patient expectations further complicated care, particularly when patients fall outside the ordinary (patient X).
abstract.textZh: PCP對管理泌尿道感染有信心，但當患者X （兒童、男性、老年患者、復發性泌尿道感染患者）出現時，會出現不確定性， PCP認為會診更複雜。這項分析強調了評估處方抗生素的風險和益處的持續和複雜的臨牀挑戰。長期資金不足、人員短缺以及醫療服務提供者與患者之間相互衝突的期望進一步加劇了護理的複雜性，特別是當患者超出正常範圍時（患者X ）。

articles.titleZh: 初級保健醫生管理尿路感染的經驗：定性證據綜合

articles.title: Sustaining a career in general practice: a qualitative study of experienced GPs in South West England
articles.authors: Khan NF, Treadgold BM, Campbell J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: General practice in the UK faces a growing retention crisis, with many experienced GPs reducing hours or leaving patient care amid rising workload and system strain. Understanding what sustains GP careers is crucial to stabilising the workforce.
abstract.textZh: 英國的一般診所面臨著日益嚴重的挽留危機，許多經驗豐富的全科醫生在工作量增加和系統緊張的情況下減少工作時間或離開患者護理。了解支撐全科醫生職業生涯的因素對於穩定勞動力至關重要。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore how experienced GPs' career intentions have evolved since the 2016 ReGROUP study and to identify factors influencing decisions to stay, reduce, or leave clinical work.
abstract.textZh: 探索自2016年ReGROUP研究以來，經驗豐富的全科醫生的職業意圖如何發展，並確定影響決定留下、減少或離開臨牀工作的因素。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A qualitative interview study was undertaken with experienced GPs in South West England, and analysed using the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) model.
abstract.textZh: 對英格蘭西南部經驗豐富的全科醫生進行了定性訪談研究，並使用就業需求資源（ JD-R ）模型進行了分析。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: We conducted 19 semi-structured interviews with GPs who had previously completed the ReGROUP survey. Transcripts were analysed thematically with input from public and professional stakeholders.
abstract.textZh: 我們對先前已完成ReGROUP調查的全科醫生進行了19次半結構化訪談。根據公眾和專業利益相關者的意見，對成績單進行了主題分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: GPs described escalating clinical and administrative workloads, moral distress, and reduced control as key pressures driving burnout and exit. Hybrid access models, secondary care workload transfer, and punitive regulatory processes intensified strain. Retention was supported by clear workload boundaries, continuity of care, supportive practice systems, portfolio careers, and collective advocacy. Some GPs maintained engagement by reshaping their roles or practice structures to regain control and sustain meaning.
abstract.textZh: 全科醫生表示，臨牀和行政工作量增加、道德困擾和控制力下降是導致過勞和退出的關鍵壓力。混合存取模式、二級護理工作量轉移和懲罰性監管流程加劇了壓力。清晰的工作負荷界限、照護的連續性、支持性實踐系統、投資組合職業和集體倡議支持了留任。一些全科醫生通過重塑他們的角色或實踐結構來保持參與，以重新獲得控制權並維持意義。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Retention depends not only on reducing workload but also on restoring the conditions that make being a 'good GP' feel possible, through continuity, manageable demand, and supportive organisational culture. Creating space for flexibility, autonomy, and role redesign may help sustain experienced GPs and strengthen workforce resilience.
abstract.textZh: 保留不僅取決於減少工作量，還取決於通過連續性、可管理的需求和支持性組織文化，恢復使「良好的全科醫生」感覺成為可能的條件。為靈活性、自主性和角色重新設計創造空間，可能有助於維持經驗豐富的全科醫生，並加強員工的韌性。

articles.titleZh: 維持全科醫生的職業生涯：對英格蘭西南部經驗豐富的全科醫生的定性研究

articles.title: Development of a novel GP continuity measurement for practices without personal lists: a two-practice pilot of the modified SLICC
articles.authors: Sidaway-Lee K, Pereira Gray D, Fearn-Smith J, Buick A, Engamba S, Khan N, Evans PH

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: It is widely recognised that continuity of GP care should be improved. This requires a continuity measure that is applicable to all practices. Previous measures have limitations.
abstract.textZh: 人們普遍認為，應改善全科醫生護理的連續性。這需要適用於所有實踐的連續性措施。先前的措施存在局限性。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To develop an improved measure of continuity of care and compare its performance with established measures.
abstract.textZh: 制定改善的護理連續性措施，並將其績效與既定措施進行比較。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Audit data were used to conduct a 1-year pilot of the measure in two suburban general practices in Devon, England.
abstract.textZh: 審計數據被用於在英格蘭德文郡的兩個郊區一般實踐中進行為期1年的測試。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: The modified St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (mSLICC) was developed; scores were calculated monthly, and compared with those generated using the St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC), the 1-year Bice-Boxerman Continuity of Care (BB), and Usual Provider of Care (UPC) indices. Proportions of patients and appointments included were calculated, with patients grouped by age, sex, 3-year appointment numbers, and frailty categories.
abstract.textZh: 修改後的St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (mSLICC)被開發出來；每月計算分數，並與使用St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC)、1年Bice-Boxerman Continuity of Care (BB)和Usual Provider of Care (UPC)指數產生的分數進行比較。計算了包括的患者和預約的比例，患者按年齡、性別、3年預約次數和虛弱類別分組。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In the two practices, the mSLICC included 19 840 of 29 127 (68.1%) appointments and a mean of 65.2% (standard deviation [SD] 6.4%) of patients with appointments. The UPC and BB included 21 032 (72.2%) appointments and 4096 (41.3%) of 9924 patients with appointments. In practice A, the mSLICC score was 52.0%, the SLICC score was 57.1%, the mean UPC score was 0.63 (95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.62 to 0.64), and the mean BB score was 0.41 (95% CI = 0.40 to 0.43). In practice B, the mSLICC score was 25.9%, the SLICC score was 25.3%, the mean UPC score was 0.50 (95% CI = 0.49 to 0.51), and the mean BB score was 0.23 (95% CI = 0.22 to 0.25). The mSLICC correlated with the SLICC (r = 0.98, P<0.001).
abstract.textZh: 在這兩種實踐中， mSLICC包括29 127名預約患者中的19 840名（ 68.1 ％ ）和65.2 ％ （標準差[SD] 6.4 ％ ）的預約患者。UPC和BB包括21,032 （ 72.2 ％ ）次預約和9924名有預約的患者中的4096 （ 41.3 ％ ）。在實踐A中， mSLICC分數為52.0 ％ ， SLICC分數為57.1 ％ ，平均UPC分數為0.63 （ 95 ％置信區間[CI] = 0.62至0.64 ） ，平均BB分數為0.41 （ 95 ％ CI = 0.40至0.43 ）。在實踐B中， mSLICC分數為25.9% ， SLICC分數為25.3% ，平均UPC分數為0.50 （ 95% CI = 0.49至0.51 ） ，平均BB分數為0.23 （ 95% CI = 0.22至0.25 ）。mSLICC與SLICC相關（ r = 0.98 ， P < 0.001 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The mSLICC is a new monthly measure of continuity. It has fewer limitations than the BB and UPC, and does not require a named GP. With sufficient IT resources, the mSLICC could be used to measure continuity of care in practices that do not use personal lists.
abstract.textZh: MSLICC是衡量連續性的新月度指標。它比BB和UPC具有更少的限制，並且不需要命名GP。有了足夠的IT資源， mSLICC可用於衡量不使用個人名單的實踐中護理的連續性。

articles.titleZh: 為沒有個人名單的實踐開發一種新穎的全科醫生連續性測量：修改後的SLICC的雙實踐試點

articles.title: General practice follow-up after hospital discharge in older adults: retrospective record analysis in UK primary care
articles.authors: Klepacz N, Long A, Shariff Z, Spencer SE, Mistry H, Griffiths F, Dale J, Spencer RA

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Most hospital admissions are for older patients, who are more likely to be medically complex. Primary care risks after hospital discharge and readmission trajectories are relatively unexplored.
abstract.textZh: 大多數住院病例是老年患者，他們更可能是醫學複雜的患者。出院和再入院軌跡後的初級保健風險相對未被探索。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To estimate the frequency and nature of errors and harms linked to discharge summary processing in general practice for patients aged ≥65 years; and to explore associations with readmission and healthcare utilisation, using a novel primary care data source.
abstract.textZh: 估計年齡≥ 65歲的患者在一般實踐中與出院摘要處理相關的錯誤和危害的頻率和性質；並使用新的初級保健數據源探索與再入院和醫療保健利用的關聯。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Retrospective cohort study using electronic health records (EHRs) from seven purposively sampled general practices in the West Midlands, UK.
abstract.textZh: 回溯性隊列研究使用來自英國西米德蘭茲郡七個有意抽樣的一般實踐的電子健康記錄（ EHR ）。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: EHRs of patients aged ≥65 years discharged between October 2022 and October 2023 were reviewed. Outcomes included post-discharge healthcare utilisation and costs, frequency and type of discharge actions, error rates (failures to complete requested actions), harms (severity, attribution, and preventability), and 90-day readmissions. Multivariable logistic regression identified predictors of errors, harms, and readmission.
abstract.textZh: 審查了2022年10月至2023年10月期間出院的年齡大於或等於65歲的患者的EHR。結果包括出院後醫療保健的使用和成本、出院行動的頻率和類型、錯誤率（未能完成請求的行動）、危害（嚴重程度、歸因和可預防性）以及90天的再入院率。多變量邏輯回歸確定了錯誤、危害和再入院的預測因子。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Within the cohort of 263 discharged patients, 186 (70.7%) accessed post-discharge care; with 47 out of the 263 patients (17.5%; 95% confidence interval = 13.7 to 23.0) having related readmissions within 90 days. In total, 551 actions were requested in 160 discharge summaries. For those patients who required an action, 20.6% experienced error and 4.4% experienced harm. Most harms resulted in hospital readmission and three out of eight were preventable in primary care. Error and harm disproportionately affected patients who had dementia or a recorded carer.
abstract.textZh: 在263名出院患者的隊列中， 186名（ 70.7 ％ ）獲得了出院後護理； 263名患者中有47名（ 17.5 ％ ； 95 ％置信區間= 13.7至23.0 ）在90天內有相關的再入院。在160份出院摘要中，共要求採取551項措施。對於需要採取行動的患者， 20.6%經歷了錯誤， 4.4%經歷了傷害。大多數傷害導致再次入院，八分之三的傷害在初級保健中是可以預防的。錯誤和傷害不成比例地影響患有失智症的患者或記錄的護理人員。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: General practice should review their processes for responding to patient discharge information in order to improve patient safety post-discharge. Further research into tools to assist practices with transitions is warranted.
abstract.textZh: 一般診所應審查其回應患者出院資訊的流程，以提高患者出院後的安全性。有必要進一步研究輔助過渡實踐的工具。

articles.title: Optimising personal continuity in general practice: process evaluation of a toolkit
articles.authors: Groot LJ, Uijen AA, Schers HJ, Burgers JS, Smalbrugge M, van der Horst HE, Maarsingh OR

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Personal continuity - having a GP who knows and follows the patient - is a core value of general practice, yet changes in society and health care have challenged its provision. Therefore, we developed TOOL-kit: an intervention to opTimise persOnal cOntinuity for oLder patients in general practice, a multi-component intervention aimed to optimise personal continuity for patients aged ≥65 years.
abstract.textZh: 個人連續性-擁有一位了解並關注患者的全科醫生-是一般實踐的核心價值觀，但社會和醫療保健的變化對其提供提出了挑戰。因此，我們開發了TOOL-kit ：一種介入措施，用於在一般實踐中為其他患者調整持續持續性，這是一種多組分介入措施，旨在為年齡大於或等於65歲的患者優化個人連續性。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate TOOL-kit's implementation and identify barriers and facilitators influencing its delivery.
abstract.textZh: 評估TOOL-kit的實施情況，並找出影響其交付的障礙和促進因素。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This mixed-methods study was embedded in the main effect trial (August 2020 to April 2022).
abstract.textZh: 這項混合方法研究已納入主效應試驗（ 2020年8月至2022年4月）。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Implementation was assessed via 3-monthly surveys and 93 interviews with GPs and practice staff (n = 221) from 31 general practices. Based on Saunders' paradigm, it was evaluated on the process indicators of recruitment and reach, fidelity (adherence to protocol), dose delivered (extent of improvement plans), and dose received (goal achievement, sustained organisational change). Barriers and facilitators were evaluated on the intervention, staff, organisational, and sociopolitical levels.
abstract.textZh: 透過31家全科醫生（ n = 221 ）的3個月調查和93次訪談評估實施情況。根據Saunders的範式，根據招募和範圍、忠誠度（遵守計畫書）、交付的劑量（改善計畫的程度）和接收的劑量（目標實現、持續的組織變革）的過程指標進行評估。在幹預、員工、組織和社會政治層面評估障礙和促進者。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 31 practices, 23 adhered to protocol. TOOL-kit was delivered at a (very) low dose in 17 of 31 practices. At study end, 55% of practice goals were met. After 24 months, 19 of 31 practices had observed sustained positive effects regarding personal continuity. A good-quality improvement infrastructure facilitated TOOL-kit implementation, while work pressure and staff shortages, exacerbated by COVID-19, were seen as the main barriers for implementation.
abstract.textZh: 在31個實踐中，有23個遵循計畫書。TOOL-kit在31個實踐中的17個實踐中以（非常）低劑量交付。研究結束時， 55%的練習目標達成。24個月後， 31個實踐中的19個觀察到個人連續性方面的持續積極影響。優質的改善基礎設施促進了TOOL-kit的實施，而工作壓力和人員短缺因新冠肺炎疫情而加劇，被視為實施的主要障礙。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Despite implementation challenges, TOOL-kit was able to enhance work procedures and improve the focus on personal continuity within practice. Fostering practices' quality improvement infrastructure and decision-making processes could improve implementation.
abstract.textZh: 儘管有實施上的挑戰， TOOL-kit還是能夠強化工作程序，並在實踐中更加專注於個人的連續性。促進實踐的質量改善基礎設施和決策過程可以改善實施。

articles.title: Histologic Features and Clinical Outcomes of Lean Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease
articles.authors: de Avila L, AlNaamani KM, Papatheodoridi M, Petta S, Hagström H, Kim SU, Nakajima A, Crespo J, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Although metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is traditionally associated with obesity, it is increasingly recognized in individuals with normal weight (ie, lean MASLD).
abstract.textZh: 雖然代謝功能障礙相關的脂肪性肝病（ MASLD ）傳統上與肥胖有關，但它在體重正常的個體（即瘦MASLD ）中越來越多地被認識。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To characterize the clinical, histologic, and prognostic features of lean MASLD, and evaluate the performance of noninvasive tests for advanced fibrosis.
abstract.textZh: 表徵精益MASLD的臨牀、組織學和預後特徵，並評估晚期纖維化的非侵入性測試的性能。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Multinational, retrospective observational study of adults with biopsy-confirmed MASLD from 41 countries from the Global MASLD project.
abstract.textZh: 來自全球MASLD項目的41個國家的成人活檢確診MASLD的跨國回顧性觀察研究。

abstract.label: EXPOSURES
abstract.text: Lean vs overweight/obese MASLD, defined by body mass index (BMI) and waist circumference.
abstract.textZh: 瘦與超重/肥胖MASLD ，由身體質量指數（ BMI ）和腰圍定義。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Primary outcomes were all-cause mortality and clinical events (hepatocellular carcinoma, hepatic decompensation, liver transplant, death), intermediate outcomes included histologic fibrosis severity, and tests included the Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) score and liver stiffness measurement (LSM) by transient elastography.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果為全因死亡率和臨牀事件（肝細胞癌、肝失代償、肝移植、死亡） ，中間結果包括組織學纖維化嚴重程度，測試包括纖維化-4 （ FIB-4 ）評分和通過短暫彈性成像進行的肝硬度測量（ LSM ）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 18 326 patients (mean [SD] age, 50.9 [13.1] years; 8714 [47.6%] male), 6.7% were lean by BMI. Among 12 202 patients with waist circumference available, 6.0% were lean by waist circumference (κ = 0.41). Lean MASLD was most prevalent in Asia (11.3% by BMI, 11.7% by waist circumference). Compared with overweight/obese MASLD, lean MASLD had lower prevalence of type 2 diabetes (38.2% vs 48.3%; difference, -10.2% [95% CI, -13.0% to -7.4%]), advanced fibrosis (29.3% vs 37.2%; difference, -7.8% [95% CI, -10.5% to -5.2%]), and Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease Activity Scores (mean [SD], 3.96 [1.81] vs 4.41 [1.68]; difference, -0.44 [95% CI, -0.56 to -0.33]). The FIB-4 demonstrated lower accuracy for predicting advanced fibrosis (F3-F4) in lean vs overweight/obese MASLD (area under the curve, 0.76 [95% CI, 0.73-0.79] vs 0.79 [95% CI, 0.78-0.80]; difference, -0.03 [95% CI, -0.06 to 0.00]), while LSM had higher accuracy (area under the curve, 0.87 [95% CI, 0.84-0.90] vs 0.83 [95% CI, 0.82-0.84]; difference, 0.04 [95% CI, 0.01-0.07]). Unadjusted rates per 100 person-years in lean vs overweight/obese MASLD were 1.08 vs 0.91 for all-cause mortality and 1.51 vs 1.43 for clinical events, respectively; lean status was not independently associated with all-cause mortality (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR], 0.90 [95% CI, 0.69-1.16]) or clinical events (aHR, 0.94 [95% CI, 0.76-1.17]). Advanced fibrosis (F3-F4) was associated with all-cause mortality (1.46 vs 0.77 per 100 person-years; aHR, 2.10 [95% CI, 1.71-2.57]) and clinical events (3.21 vs 0.89 per 100 person-years; aHR, 3.41 [95% CI, 2.90-4.03]).

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Lean MASLD represents a distinct phenotype with milder histologic disease but similar clinical outcomes compared with overweight/obese MASLD. Fibrosis severity, rather than body composition, was associated with prognosis and LSM was reliable in lean individuals.

articles.title: Exercise Therapy and Education for Young Adults With Persistent Knee Problems After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction : A Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Culvenor AG, Bruder AM, West TJ, Barton CJ, Roos EM, Oei EH, McPhail SM, Souza RB, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Chronic knee symptoms and early-onset osteoarthritis are common after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR). Evidence to inform management is needed.

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate whether physiotherapist-supervised exercise therapy with education is superior to a single education session and self-directed exercise resource for young adults with persistent knee problems after ACLR.

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Parallel-group randomized trial. (Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry: ACTRN12620001164987).

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Community.

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 184 young adults (aged 18 to 40 years) with persistent knee problems 9 to 36 months after ACLR.

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: A 4-month twice-weekly physiotherapist-supervised exercise therapy program with education (SUPER [SUpervised exercise-therapy and Patient Education Rehabilitation]; n = 92) and a single physiotherapist-delivered education session and self-directed exercise resource (control; n = 92).

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Primary outcome was 4-month change in the composite Knee injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score (KOOS4; 0= worst, 100= best). Secondary outcomes included KOOS4 at 12 months and thigh muscle strength, patient-perceived global rating of change, and cartilage thickness and composition on magnetic resonance imaging at 4 and 12 months.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: 184 participants were randomly assigned (mean age, 30 years [SD, 6]; 2.2 years [SD, 0.7] after ACLR); 178 (97%) and 174 (95%) completed 4-month and 12-month follow-up, respectively. At 4 months, KOOS4 scores improved more in the SUPER group than in the control group (14.1 vs. 9.4; adjusted mean difference, 4.8 [95% CI, 1.4 to 8.2]). At 4 months, SUPER resulted in greater muscle strength gains and higher rates of success on global rating of change (for example, pain 73% vs. 40%). Between-group differences narrowed at 12 months as the control group continued to improve, whereas SUPER gains were sustained. There were no between-group differences seen in cartilage thickness or composition.

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Unblinded participants.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: For young adults with persistent knee problems after ACLR, physiotherapist-supervised exercise therapy with education improved patient-reported outcomes compared with a single education session and self-directed exercise resource, but these between-group differences may not be sustained over time.

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: National Health and Medical Research Council.

articles.title: Tobacco Use Treatment: Synopsis of the 2026 U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and U.S. Department of Defense Clinical Practice Guideline
articles.authors: Myers MG, Vu PA, Calhoun PS, Chen T, Cook JW, Fu SS, Geraci MC, Hayes JA, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: A work group representing the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) prepared a new VA/DoD clinical practice guideline (CPG) for tobacco use treatment. This article provides a synopsis of the 2026 CPG, which addresses use of commercially available tobacco and nicotine products.
abstract.textZh: 代表美國退伍軍人事務部（ VA ）和美國國防部（ DoD ）的工作組準備了新的VA/DoD煙草使用治療臨牀實踐指南（ CPG ）。本文概述了2026年消費物價指數，其中涉及市售煙草和尼古丁產品的使用。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: A multidisciplinary work group developed 19 key questions on clinical topics of highest priority for the VA and DoD populations. Published literature from 1 January 2014 to 10 December 2024 was systematically reviewed using the PICOTS (population, intervention, comparator, outcomes, timing of outcomes measurement, and setting) framework. Recommendations were made by consensus and informed by evaluation using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) method, which assesses quality of evidence and balances benefits and harms, patient preferences, and feasibility. The final document incorporated input from peer review by an external group of experts.
abstract.textZh: 一個多學科工作小組針對退伍軍人管理局和國防部人羣的最高優先臨牀主題制定了19個關鍵問題。2014年1月1日至2024年12月10日期間發表的文獻使用PICOT （人口、幹預、比較器、結果、結果測量時間和設定）框架進行了系統性審查。建議以共識方式提出，並使用GRADE （建議評估，開發和評估的評級）方法進行評估，該方法評估證據的質量並平衡利益和傷害，患者偏好和可行性。最終文件納入了外部專家小組同行評審的意見。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: The 2026 guideline includes 32 recommendations across 10 topic areas. Key recommendations for increasing abstinence from combustible tobacco include recommending motivational interviewing to increase engagement in treatment of tobacco and nicotine use (strong) and use of U.S. Food and Drug Administration-approved pharmacotherapies (strong), with varenicline recommended over monotherapy with other agents (strong), combination nicotine replacement therapy ([NRT] for example, patch plus lozenge) recommended over NRT monotherapy (single agent) (strong), and extending use of bupropion sustained release beyond 12 weeks (weak). Other key recommendations include varenicline for increasing abstinence from smokeless tobacco (strong) and electronic nicotine delivery systems (weak) and use of NRT or varenicline to increase quit attempts and abstinence in patients not ready to quit in the next 30 days (weak).
abstract.textZh: 2026年準則包括10個主題領域的32項建議。增加可燃煙草禁慾的主要建議包括建議進行動機訪談，以增加對煙草和尼古丁使用的治療（強）和使用美國食品和藥物管理局批準的藥物治療（強） ，建議使用伐尼克林而不是使用其他藥物進行單一治療（強） ，建議使用尼古丁替代療法（ [NRT]例如，貼片加錠劑）而不是NRT單一治療（單一藥物） （強） ，並將丁丙酮持續釋放的使用延長至12週以後（弱）。其他主要建議包括伐尼克蘭增加無煙煙草（強）和電子尼古丁輸送系統（弱）的禁慾，以及使用NRT或伐尼克蘭增加戒菸嘗試和未準備好在未來30天內戒菸的患者禁慾（弱）。
