articles.title: Prescriber Practices and Barriers to Providing Prescription Medication Instructions for Patients With a Non-English Language Preference
articles.authors: Manzor B, Ramírez JL, Lanchoney OWL, Collins V, Hughey KL

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Patients in the United States with limited English proficiency, referred to as a non-English language preference, are at risk for serious negative medication-related outcomes. Evidence suggests that these negative outcomes are associated with miscommunication of prescription medication instructions between prescribers and patients and between prescribers and dispensing pharmacies. We sought to explore relevant practices and barriers.
abstract.textZh: 美國英語水平有限的患者（稱為非英語偏好）有嚴重藥物相關不良結果的風險。有證據表明，這些負面結果與處方者和患者之間以及處方者和配藥藥房之間處方藥物說明溝通不暢有關。我們試圖探索相關做法和障礙。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We recruited outpatient prescribers from a large academic medical health center via an e-mail listserv. We developed and distributed a questionnaire to identify prescribers' practices, barriers, and interactions with patients, interpreters, and pharmacies regarding provision of non-English prescription medication instructions.
abstract.textZh: 我們通過電子郵件列表服務器從大型學術醫療保健中心招募門診處方師。我們開發並分發了一份問卷，以確定處方者在提供非英語處方藥物說明方面的做法、障礙以及與患者、口譯員和藥房的互動。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 477 e-mail addresses on the listserv, 169 (35.4%) prescribers completed the questionnaire. The prescribers were predominantly White (73.4%), female (75.7%), and physicians (doctors of medicine or doctors of osteopathic medicine, 86.0%), and they had an average age of 41.0 years. The majority (61.5%) reported a lack of awareness of best practices to provide non-English instructions to patients or pharmacies, and most (91.8%) did not inform patients that they could request a non-English medication label from their pharmacy. Many prescribers (69.8%) did not feel confident that their patients with a non-English language preference received accurate written medication instructions.
abstract.textZh: 在清單服務器上的477個電子郵件地址中，有169名（ 35.4 ％ ）處方者填寫了問卷。處方者以白人(73.4%)、女性(75.7%)和醫生(醫生或骨科醫生， 86.0%)為主，平均年齡為41.0歲。大多數（ 61.5 ％ ）報告缺乏對向患者或藥房提供非英語說明的最佳做法的認識，大多數（ 91.8 ％ ）沒有告知患者他們可以向藥房申請非英語藥物標籤。許多處方者（ 69.8% ）對非英語偏好的患者收到正確的書面用藥說明沒有信心。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Prescribers reported confusion about the role of the dispensing pharmacy and varied regarding their expectations and provision of non-English medication instructions. Access to medication information in languages other than English is facilitated when prescribers and pharmacies know and follow best practices for language access plans and use of language services.
abstract.textZh: 處方者報告說，他們對配藥藥房的作用感到困惑，並對他們的期望和非英語用藥說明有所不同。當處方師和藥房知道並遵循語言訪問計劃和使用語言服務的最佳做法時，便於以英語以外的語言訪問藥物信息。

articles.title: What It Cost and What It Gave to Become an Undocumented Family Physician
articles.authors: Ruiz J

abstract.text: Growing up as an undocumented immigrant in North Carolina shaped not only the author's path to medicine, but also how they understand patients, systems, and belonging. In this reflective essay, they describe the fear, uncertainty, and exclusion that marked their medical training in the United States while undocumented, despite academic achievement and a longstanding desire to become a physician. Policies designed to limit opportunity repeatedly threatened their progression, not because they lacked ability, but because institutions often viewed undocumented trainees as a risk. Although Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) allowed them to continue training, instability and uncertainty persisted. Now practicing rural family medicine with obstetrics, the author recognizes similar fears and structural barriers in patients who delay or avoid care because of exclusion, vulnerability, or mistrust. abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Quality improvement (QI) is a core component of family medicine residency training, preparing physicians to lead system-level changes and deliver value-based care. However, there is no standardized curriculum or metric for evaluating success of residency QI projects and a lack of consensus on best practices for QI education and assessment in graduate medical education. abstract.textZh: 質量改善（ QI ）是家庭醫學住院醫師培訓的核心組成部分，為醫師領導系統級變革和提供以價值為基礎的護理做好準備。然而，沒有標準化的課程或指標來評估住院QI項目的成功，也缺乏對研究生醫學教育中QI教育和評估的最佳實踐的共識。我們試圖描述美國家庭醫學住院醫師目前的QI課程環境，包括教學方法、項目要求、教師角色以及成功和障礙的感知標誌。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This study was part of the 2025 Council of Academic Family Medicine Educational Research Alliance cross-sectional survey of family medicine residency program directors. Graduate QI proficiency was mostly rated as intermediate (63.5%). Greater graduate proficiency was significantly associated with programs reporting hybrid curricula, fewer barriers to data access, continuity of projects, and greater dissemination and implementation of project outcomes (all P < .05).

articles.title: Identifying Hazardous Alcohol Use in Primary Care: Concordance Between Phosphatidylethanol and Self-Reports
articles.authors: Månsson V, Hammarberg A, Guterstam J, LoMartire R

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Screening for hazardous alcohol use is a challenging task in primary care. We examined concordance between the alcohol biomarker phosphatidylethanol (PEth) and 2 self-reported measures of alcohol use-score on a screening questionnaire and weekly drinks-in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 在初級保健中，篩查有害酒精使用是一項具有挑戰性的任務。我們檢查了酒精生物標誌物磷脂酰乙醇（ PEth ）和2項自我報告的酒精使用量度之間的一致性-篩選問卷和每週飲酒-初級保健。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using regional primary care health records linked to national registries in Sweden. Analyses used 2 samples: (1) patients with a PEth test who also had an Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test (AUDIT) score in the preceding or following 90 days (n = 3,679) and (2) patients with a PEth test who also had a documented self-reported weekly alcohol use in the preceding or following 90 days (n = 8,934). We defined hazardous alcohol use as a PEth level of greater than 210 ng/mL (0.30 μmol/L), an AUDIT score of 8 or higher, and a reported consumption of 10 or more drinks per week. Associations between PEth and self-reports were examined using correlation analyses and proportional-odds models adjusted for sociodemographic and clinical characteristics.
abstract.textZh: 我們使用與瑞典國家登記處相關的區域初級保健健康記錄進行了回溯性隊列研究。分析使用了2個樣本： (1)在90天之前或之後也進行酒精使用障礙識別測試(AUDIT)評分的PEth測試患者(n = 3,679)和(2)在90天之前或之後也進行有記錄的每週自我報告酒精使用的PEth測試患者(n = 8,934)。我們將有害酒精使用定義為PEth水平高於210 ng/mL (0.30 μmol/L)、稽核分數為8分或更高，以及每週飲用10杯或更多飲料。使用相關性分析和根據社會人口和臨牀特徵調整的比例ODDS模型檢查PEth和自我報告之間的關聯。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The prevalence of hazardous alcohol use varied substantially by assessment method. The AUDIT questionnaire classified the largest proportion of patients as having hazardous use (26.5%), followed by PEth level (14.6% and 18.3% in the first and second samples, respectively) and by reported weekly drinks (8.5%). Each method identified patients not detected by the others. PEth levels correlated moderately with both AUDIT scores and weekly alcohol consumption, but relationships were nonlinear. At similar PEth levels, men and patients with higher education or income reported greater weekly alcohol use, while younger patients had higher AUDIT scores.
abstract.textZh: 使用有害酒精的普遍程度因評估方法而異。稽核問卷將最大比例的患者分類為有危險使用（ 26.5 ％ ） ，其次是PEth水平（第一和第二個樣本分別為14.6 ％和18.3 ％ ）以及每週報告的飲料（ 8.5 ％ ）。每種方法都能識別出其他方法未檢測到的患者。PEth水平與稽核分數和每週飲酒量均有中度相關性，但關係是非線性的。在類似的PEth水平下，受過高等教育或收入的男性和患者報告每週酒精使用量較高，而年輕患者的稽核分數較高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: An alcohol biomarker and self-reported measures capture overlapping but distinct aspects of alcohol use in primary care. For primary care clinicians, PEth should be interpreted alongside self-reported measures rather than used as a standalone test. Combining assessment methods may improve identification of alcohol-related risk and support more individualized, context-sensitive clinical conversations.
abstract.textZh: 酒精生物標誌物和自我報告的措施捕捉了初級保健中酒精使用的重疊但截然不同的方面。對於初級保健臨牀醫生， PEth應與自我報告的措施一起解釋，而不是用作獨立測試。結合評估方法可以改善酒精相關風險的識別，並支持更個性化、上下文敏感的臨牀對話。

articles.title: Assessing 5-Year Outcomes of a Teamlet Care Model in Singapore Polyclinics: A Matched Difference-in-Difference Analysis
articles.authors: Wye Wong SK, Tan KB, Pang J, Wong V, Liang Ng DW, Yung Tan DH, Lim Z, Sundram M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: A novel teamlet (small team) care model was introduced in 2014 within Singapore polyclinics to improve care continuity and comprehensiveness for patients with chronic disease. Patients were enrolled in smaller teams comprising 2 family physicians, 1 nurse, and 1 care coordinator for coordinated team-based care. This study assessed 5-year outcomes focusing on clinical parameters, care adherence, health care utilization, and economic impact.
abstract.textZh: 2014年，新加坡多家診所引入了一種新的teamlet （小團隊）護理模式，以改善慢性病患者的護理連續性和全面性。患者被招募到較小的團隊中，包括2名家庭醫生、1名護士和1名護理協調員，以協調團隊為基礎的護理。本研究評估了5年結果，重點是臨牀參數、護理依從性、醫療保健利用率和經濟影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a retrospective matched cohort study of patients with diabetes, hypertension, or hyperlipidemia enrolled in the teamlet program from 2014 to 2016. Outcomes were compared with matched control patients receiving usual care. We analyzed data from Singapore's Ministry of Health databases using difference-in-differences analysis, controlling for individual and cohort-time fixed effects.
abstract.textZh: 我們對2014年至2016年參與teamlet計劃的糖尿病、高血壓或高脂血症患者進行了回顧性匹配隊列研究。將結果與接受常規護理的匹配對照患者進行比較。我們使用差異分析來分析來自新加坡衛生部數據庫的數據，控制個人和隊列時間固定效應。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The teamlet model achieved modest clinical improvements; glycated hemoglobin decreased by 0.1% for subgroups with nonincreasing HbA1c before empanelment, systolic blood pressure decreased by 0.65 mm Hg, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol decreased by 0.03 mmol/L. However, diabetes screening adherence improved, with 16% more foot screenings and 6% more eye screenings compared with control patients. Health care utilization shifted toward primary care, with decreased inpatient hospitalizations (SGD $2,432 savings per person), decreased specialist outpatient visits (SGD $130 savings per person), fewer emergency department visits (SGD $49 savings per person), but increased polyclinic utilization cost (SGD $479 per person). Overall cost savings totaled SGD $2,186 per patient.
abstract.textZh: Teamlet模型實現了適度的臨牀改善；糖化血紅蛋白(Glycated hemoglobin)在HbA1c未增加的次組中減少了0.1% ，收縮壓(systolic blood pressure)減少了0.65 mm Hg ，低密度脂蛋白膽固醇(low-density lipoprotein cholesterol)減少了0.03 mmol/L。然而，糖尿病篩查依從性有所改善，與對照患者相比，足部篩查增加了16% ，眼睛篩查增加了6%。醫療保健使用轉向初級保健，住院病人住院費用減少（每人節省$ 2,432新元） ，專科門診就診人數減少（每人節省$ 130新元） ，急診部門就診人數減少（每人節省$ 49新元） ，但複合診所使用成本增加（每人$ 479新元）。每位患者總共節省了2,186新元$。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Restructuring polyclinic workforces into smaller collaborative teams improved care processes and decreased high-cost health care utilization. articles.authors: Lan J, Liu S, Chen H, Zhang T, Zeng P, Li J, Jin L, Tan T, et al.

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of disability and death, and early identification of carotid atherosclerotic plaques is critical for stroke prevention in primary care and community settings. We examined whether artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced handheld ultrasound (HHUS) could improve carotid plaque detection and stenosis assessment in community-based primary care screening.
abstract.textZh: 缺血性中風是殘疾和死亡的主要原因，早期識別頸動脈粥樣硬化斑塊對於初級保健和社區環境中的中風預防至關重要。我們研究了人工智能（ AI ）增強型手持超聲波（ HHUS ）是否可以改善基於社區的初級保健篩查中的頸動脈斑塊檢測和狹窄評估。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We developed a super-resolution reconstruction model (Hyper-CycleGAN) and validated it in a clinical cohort of 127 patients with 198 plaques. The validated model was then applied in a community screening setting with 117 participants and 153 plaques, using portable ultrasound as the reference standard. We evaluated agreement with the reference standard (Bland-Altman, intraclass correlation coefficient) and community diagnostic performance (detection rates, quadratic-weighted Cohen κ, confusion matrices, and standard metrics).
abstract.textZh: 我們開發了一個超分辨率重建模型（ Hyper-CycleGAN ） ，並在127名患者與198個斑塊的臨牀隊列中進行了驗證。然後使用便攜式超聲波作為參考標準，將經過驗證的模型應用於有117名參與者和153個斑塊的社區篩選環境中。我們評估了與參考標準(Bland-Altman ，類內相關係數)和社區診斷績效(檢測率、二次加權Cohen κ、混淆矩陣和標準指標)的一致性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In community screening, AI-enhanced HHUS identified 94.8% of carotid plaques compared with 87.6% using standard HHUS. Agreement in stenosis grading with the reference standard improved, with weighted κ increasing from 0.492 to 0.836. Sensitivity for identifying ultrasound-defined vulnerable plaques increased from 47.4% to 63.2%, and specificity remained high.
abstract.textZh: 在社區篩選中， AI增強型HHUS鑑定出94.8%的頸動脈斑塊，而使用標準HHUS鑑定出87.6%的頸動脈斑塊。狹窄分級與參考標準的一致性得到改善，加權κ從0.492增加到0.836。識別超聲定義的脆弱斑塊的靈敏度從47.4%增加到63.2% ，特異性仍然很高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: AI-enhanced HHUS improved carotid plaque detection and stenosis assessment in community screening, supporting more accurate risk stratification and referral decisions in primary care. This approach could expand access to low-cost stroke prevention strategies in underserved communities.Abstract available in: يبرع (Arabic); (Chinese); Francais (French); Deutsch (German); हिन्दी (Hindi); Indonesian (Indonesian); (Japanese); Portugues (Portuguese); Español (Spanish).

articles.authors: Ferrin AA, Khudaier SE, Martinez J, Matz C, Cui S, Jabbarpour Y, Fortuna KL

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: In 2024, Medicare introduced principal illness navigation peer support (PIN-PS) reimbursement codes, creating the first nationwide reimbursement mechanism specifically for peer-delivered support services under Medicare. Little is known about early implementation of these codes. This study identified barriers and facilitators to PIN-PS adoption across clinical, organizational, and policy settings.
abstract.textZh: 2024年， Medicare引入了主要疾病導航同儕支援(PIN-PS)報銷代碼，創建了第一個全國性的報銷機制，專門為Medicare下的同儕提供支援服務。對於這些守則的早期實施知之甚少。本研究確定了在臨牀、組織和政策環境中採用PIN-PS的障礙和促進因素。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted semi-structured, qualitative interviews with 20 participants representing physicians, certified peer support specialists and leaders, policy professionals, payer representatives, and behavioral health or recovery organizational leaders. Interviews were analyzed using the Rigorous and Accelerated Data Reduction technique and guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research.
abstract.textZh: 我們對代表醫生、認證同儕支援專家和領導者、政策專業人士、付款人代表以及行為健康或恢復組織領導者的20名參與者進行了半結構化的定性訪談。採訪使用嚴格和加速數據減少技術進行分析，並在實施研究綜合框架的指導下進行。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Barriers included limited awareness of PIN-PS codes, administrative and billing complexity, cost-sharing requirements, and constraints in reimbursable service time. Facilitators included perceived benefits for care coordination and workflow, alignment with broader policy priorities, and organizational readiness to integrate peer support into care teams. Perspectives on implementation varied across clinical and organizational settings.
abstract.textZh: 障礙包括對PIN-PS代碼的認識有限、行政和帳單複雜性、成本分攤要求以及可報銷服務時間的限制。培訓人員包括護理協調和工作流程的感知益處、與更廣泛的政策優先順序保持一致，以及組織準備將同儕支持整合到護理團隊中。實施的觀點因臨牀和組織環境而異。

abstract.text: Early implementation of PIN-PS codes appears to be shaped by the interaction of perceived value and practical implementation challenges. Efforts to support adoption may benefit from reducing administrative burden, improving dissemination and guidance, and aligning reimbursement structures with the nature of peer support. These findings may inform ongoing implementation and policy refinement.Abstract available in: يبرع (Arabic); हिन्दी (Chinese); Francais (French); Deutsch (German); हिन्दी (Hindi); Indonesian (Indonesian); (Japanese); Portugues (Portuguese); Español (Spanish).

articles.authors: Ko HJ, Jackson JLN, Thompson-Lastad A, Wennik J, Swedlow P, Chao MT

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Social support is associated with improved outcomes for people with chronic pain and is an important but understudied component of biopsychosocial pain care. We sought to explore how group medical visits facilitate 4 distinct types of social support-emotional, appraisal, informational, and instrumental-among primary care patients with chronic pain.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We collected qualitative data within a randomized trial of integrative group medical visits for chronic pain, focusing on 2 cohorts of English-speaking patients randomized to group medical visits. Data came from 16 observed group medical visits, 2 focus groups, and 12 semistructured interviews. The group medical visit intervention entailed 12 weekly sessions combining clinical care, pain education, mindfulness meditation, therapeutic movement, and facilitated discussion. We analyzed data using team-based flexible coding and codebook thematic analysis.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The 26 participating patients were predominantly low-income (80.8% had an annual household income of less than $50,000); 50.0% identified as Black or African American, 15.4% as Hispanic or Latine, and 23.1% as White. On average, they had severe pain with a mean intensity rating of 7.7 out of 10. All 4 social support types emerged through structured program components (curriculum, facilitation strategies, program structure) and interactions among peers and facilitators. Emotional support fostered belonging and countered isolation and stigma. Appraisal support normalized struggles and fostered self-compassion. Informational support combined interactive education with peer-to-peer knowledge exchange. Instrumental support provided concrete assistance.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Our findings illustrate how group medical visits for chronic pain mobilize 4 interwoven and reinforcing forms of social support as core therapeutic processes. They also highlight group medical visits as a potential model for biopsychosocial chronic pain management among primary care patients.

articles.title: Influence of Physician Behaviors on How Patients Interpret Normal Test Results
articles.authors: Kube T, Seewald A

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Reassuring patients that nothing serious is wrong is one of the most common interventions in family medicine. However, medical reassurance can sometimes fail, and it is not yet clear what role the doctor's behavior plays in this regard. We tested the preregistered hypothesis that a doctor's warmth and competence significantly and independently influence patients' responses to normal results from diagnostic testing.
abstract.textZh: 向患者保證沒有任何嚴重問題是家庭醫學中最常見的幹預措施之一。然而，醫療保證有時會失敗，目前還不清楚醫生的行為在這方面扮演什麼角色。我們測試了預先註冊的假設，即醫生的溫暖和能力顯著且獨立地影響患者對診斷測試正常結果的反應。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We used an online convenience sample reporting medium somatic symptom burden (N = 349, mean age 29.9 years, 79% female) and completed an experimental analog study. After presentation of a symptom vignette, participants watched a videotaped medical report in which a doctor provided the results of diagnostic tests, stating that no abnormality had been identified. Whereas the diagnostic information was always the same, the doctor's behavior differed in terms of warmth (high vs low) and competence (high vs low).
abstract.textZh: 我們使用在線便利樣本報告中等軀體症狀負擔（ N = 349 ，平均年齡29.9歲， 79 ％為女性） ，並完成了一項實驗類比研究。在呈現症狀暈影後，參與者觀看了一份醫療報告錄像，其中醫生提供了診斷測試的結果，指出沒有發現異常。儘管診斷資訊始終相同，但醫生的行為在溫暖（高與低）和能力（高與低）方面有所不同。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants rated the likelihood of a serious disease significantly lower if the doctor showed high warmth and high competence. Further results showed that high warmth and competence also led to improvements in other outcomes, such as a lower desire to seek another doctor's opinion or additional tests. A mediation analysis indicated that the effects of warmth and competence were modulated by the extent to which participants cognitively (de)valued diagnostic information.
abstract.textZh: 如果醫生表現出高熱情和高能力，參與者對嚴重疾病的可能性評分顯著降低。進一步的結果表明，高熱情和能力也導致其他結果的改善，例如尋求另一位醫生的意見或額外測試的慾望降低。調解分析表明，溫暖和能力的影響受到參與者認知（去）價值診斷信息的程度的調節。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: For patients, diagnostic information does not speak for itself; the doctor's behavior critically determines how they integrate such information. Showing high warmth and competence can help patients put trust in them and update their illness beliefs accordingly.
abstract.textZh: 對於患者來說，診斷資訊並不能說明一切；醫生的行為關鍵決定了他們如何整合這些資訊。展現高度的熱情和能力可以幫助患者信任他們，並相應地更新他們的疾病信念。

articles.title: Evaluation and Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease: Synopsis of the Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline
articles.authors: Hedayati SS, Babitt JL, Berns JS, Bozkurt B, Cheung RS, Cuevas Y, Effa EE, Eisenga MF, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: The Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) provides an update of the 2012 version. Its scope includes anemia diagnosis and use of iron therapy, erythropoiesis-stimulating agents (ESAs), hypoxia-inducible factor-prolyl hydroxylase inhibitors (HIF-PHIs), and red blood cell (RBC) transfusions to treat anemia in CKD.
abstract.textZh: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)提供了2012年版本的更新。其範圍包括貧血診斷和使用鐵療法、紅細胞生成刺激劑（ ESA ）、低氧誘導因子-脯氨酰羥化酶抑制劑（ HIF-PHI ）和紅細胞（ RBC ）輸血來治療CKD中的貧血。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: An international work group of patient partners, health care professionals, researchers, and clinicians defined the guideline scope. An independent evidence review team conducted systematic reviews through October 2024 and graded the certainty of evidence using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) approach. The final guideline incorporated feedback from a public review involving registered stakeholders in late 2024.
abstract.textZh: 由患者合作夥伴、醫療保健專業人員、研究人員和臨牀醫生組成的國際工作小組確定了指南範圍。獨立證據審查團隊在2024年10月前進行了系統審查，並使用GRADE （建議評估、發展和評估的評分）方法對證據的確定性進行了評分。最終準則納入了2024年底由註冊利益相關者參與的公開評價意見。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: This synopsis focuses on the 8 graded recommendations. Key points include the use of transferrin saturation and ferritin thresholds to guide iron therapy, with intravenous iron preferred over oral iron in people receiving hemodialysis; addressing correctable causes of anemia before use of an ESA or a HIF-PHI; using an ESA rather than a HIF-PHI as first-line treatment; individualized hemoglobin (Hb) thresholds for ESA initiation based on patient characteristics, symptoms, and values; and an upper Hb target of below 11.5 g/dL (<115 g/L) during ESA maintenance therapy. The guideline also includes 49 practice points representing expert consensus where robust evidence was limited or systematic review could not be conducted.
abstract.textZh: 本大綱重點介紹8項評分建議。關鍵點包括使用轉鐵蛋白飽和度和鐵蛋白閾值來指導鐵療法，在接受血液透析的人羣中，靜脈注射鐵優於口服鐵；在使用ESA或HIF-PHI之前解決貧血的可糾正原因；使用ESA而不是HIF-PHI作為一線治療；根據患者特徵、症狀和值， ESA啟動的個性化血紅蛋白(Hb)閾值；以及在ESA維持治療期間，血紅蛋白上限目標低於11.5 g/dL (< 115 g/L)。該指南還包括代表專家共識的49個實踐點，其中有力的證據有限或無法進行系統審查。

articles.titleZh: 慢性腎臟疾病貧血的評估和處理：腎臟疾病概要：改善全球預後2026臨牀實踐指南

articles.title: A Synopsis of the 2025 U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and U.S. Department of Defense Clinical Practice Guideline for Lipid Management for Cardiovascular Disease Risk Reduction
articles.authors: Arnold MJ, Spacek L, Bush KNV, Waring AA, Ballard-Hernandez J, Beckman D, Kelley C, Natarajan S, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: In December 2025, the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) released a clinical practice guideline (CPG) update on lipid management for cardiovascular disease risk reduction in adults. This synopsis reviews the 2025 updates and describes the major recommendations.
abstract.textZh: 2025年12月，美國退伍軍人事務部（ VA ）和美國國防部（ DoD ）發布了成人心血管疾病風險降低的血脂管理臨牀實踐指南（ CPG ）更新。本摘要回顧2025年的更新內容，並說明主要建議。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: The VA/DoD guideline development team updated the 2020 VA/DoD lipid management CPG with clinical stakeholders. The guideline panel developed 12 key questions, systematically evaluated the literature (English-language publications from 16 May 2019 to 15 January 2025), and developed 24 evidence-based recommendations. The recommendations were graded using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) system.
abstract.textZh: 退伍軍人事務部/國防部指南開發團隊與臨牀利益相關者更新了2020年退伍軍人事務部/國防部血脂管理CPG。指南小組制定了12個關鍵問題，系統地評估了文獻（ 2019年5月16日至2025年1月15日的英文出版物） ，並制定了24個以證據為基礎的建議。使用GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation)系統對建議進行評分。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: This synopsis highlights key recommendations for lipid management that are new or differ from other guideline recommendations. This update recommends the Predicting Risk of Cardiovascular Disease EVENTs (PREVENT) calculator for risk estimation in primary prevention and removes a previous recommendation against routine lipid monitoring. Two new risk refinement strategies were added: Coronary artery calcium testing is suggested for patients with clinical uncertainty and intermediate-to-high calculated risk, and one-time lipoprotein(a) testing is recommended to identify patients with enhanced cardiovascular risk. For primary prevention, moderate-intensity statins remain the recommended treatment for those at higher risk and should be considered for those at intermediate risk. A new recommendation suggests moderate-intensity statins for adults living with HIV even when 10-year risk is low. This update shifts toward more intensive lipid-lowering therapy for secondary prevention. For very high-risk patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, the guideline now suggests combination therapy with high-intensity or maximally tolerated statins plus ezetimibe and/or proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors. For statin-intolerant patients, alternatives include bempedoic acid, ezetimibe, fibrates, or PCSK9 monoclonal antibody inhibitors.
abstract.textZh: 本摘要強調了血脂管理的主要建議，這些建議是新的或與其他指南建議不同的。 此更新建議使用預測心血管疾病事件風險（ PREVENT ）計算器進行一級預防中的風險估計，並刪除先前針對常規血脂監測的建議。 增加了兩種新的風險精細化策略：建議對臨牀不確定性和中高計算風險的患者進行冠狀動脈鈣檢測，並建議進行一次性脂蛋白（ a ）檢測以識別心血管風險增加的患者。 對於一級預防，中等強度的他汀類藥物仍然是高風險患者的建議治療方法，應考慮適用於中等風險患者。 一項新的建議建議，即使在10年風險較低的情況下，成人艾滋病毒感染者也應服用中等強度的他汀類藥物。 此更新將轉向更密集的降脂治療，用於二級預防。 對於患有動脈粥樣硬化性心血管疾病的非常高風險患者，指南現在建議使用高強度或最大耐受的他汀類藥物加上依澤替米布和/或前蛋白轉化酶枯草杆菌素/kexin 9型（ PCSK9 ）抑制劑進行聯合治療。 對於他汀類藥物不耐受的患者，替代品包括苯哌酮酸、依齊替米布、纖維酸鹽或PCSK9單株抗體抑製劑。

articles.titleZh: 2025年美國退伍軍人事務部和美國國防部降低心血管疾病風險的血脂管理臨牀實踐指南概要

articles.title: Interventions to Improve Outpatient Follow-up for Hospitalized Patients With Alcohol Use Disorder : A Systematic Review
articles.authors: Bernstein EY, Hills-Dunlap K, Challapalli A, Bero L, Calcaterra SL, Edelman EJ, Kruse GR, Harnke B, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Hospitalizations for alcohol use disorder (AUD) are common and morbid. Outpatient follow-up after discharge is critical for reducing alcohol use and subsequent readmissions, but effective interventions to support this transition are unknown.
abstract.textZh: 因酒精使用障礙（ AUD ）住院治療是常見且病態的。出院後的門診追蹤對於減少酒精使用和隨後的再入院至關重要，但支持這種過渡的有效幹預措施尚不清楚。

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: To summarize evidence on the effectiveness of hospital-based interventions to improve outpatient follow-up for AUD.
abstract.textZh: 總結有關以醫院為基礎的幹預措施有效性的證據，以改善AUD的門診隨訪。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: Ovid MEDLINE, EMBASE, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, PsycInfo, and CINAHL (January 2000 to February 2025).
abstract.textZh: Ovid MEDLINE、EMBASE、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、PsycInfo和CINAHL （ 2000年1月至2025年2月）。

abstract.label: STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: Two authors independently reviewed abstracts and full-text articles to identify hospital-based trials and cohort studies that evaluated interventions to improve outpatient AUD follow-up versus usual care or an active comparator.
abstract.textZh: 兩位作者獨立審查了摘要和全文文章，以確定以醫院為基礎的試驗和隊列研究，這些試驗和研究評估介入措施，以改善門診AUD隨訪與常規護理或活躍對照者。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION
abstract.text: Study data were extracted by 2 authors using a standardized template. Risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool, Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation).
abstract.textZh: 研究資料由2位作者使用標準化範本提取。使用Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool、Newcastle-Ottawa Scale和GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation)評估偏誤風險和證據的確定性。

abstract.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Seventeen studies of 21 interventions (12 randomized clinical trials [RCTs] [n = 1917], 3 nonrandomized trials [n = 459], and 2 cohort studies [n = 9974]) were included. Interventions were heterogeneous, and most (85%) included several components: behavioral (76%), care coordination (76%), medication management (14%), and social support (33%). Eight interventions (38%) reported improved linkage to outpatient follow-up. Effective interventions generally combined behavioral and care coordination with AUD medications or social support. Effect sizes across RCTs ranged from an 8% absolute decrease to a 30% absolute increase in outpatient follow-up. The certainty of evidence was low due to the high risk of bias and imprecision of results.
abstract.textZh: 納入了21項幹預措施的17項研究（ 12項隨機臨牀試驗[RCT] [n = 1917]、3項非隨機試驗[n = 459]和2項隊列研究[n = 9974] ）。介入是異質的，大多數（ 85 ％ ）包括幾個組成部分：行為（ 76 ％ ）、護理協調（ 76 ％ ）、藥物管理（ 14 ％ ）和社會支持（ 33 ％ ）。八項幹預措施（ 38 ％ ）報告與門診隨訪的聯繫有所改善。有效的幹預措施通常將行為和護理協調與澳元藥物或社會支持結合起來。RCT的效果大小從門診隨訪的8%絕對減少到30%絕對增加不等。由於偏見和結果不準確的風險很高，證據的確定性很低。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Only English-language publications were included.
abstract.textZh: 只包括英文出版物。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Few intervention studies of low certainty improved posthospitalization follow-up for patients with AUD. Given the substantial morbidity associated with untreated AUD, high-quality RCTs testing various components of interventions are needed.
abstract.textZh: 很少有低確定性的幹預研究改善了AUD患者的住院後隨訪。鑑於與未治療的澳元相關的大量發病率，需要高質量的RCT來測試幹預措施的各個組成部分。

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: None. (PROSPERO: CRD42025636943).
abstract.textZh: 無。（ PROSPERO ： CRD42025636943 ）。

articles.title: Association Between Blood Hemoglobin Concentration and Mortality by Age and Sex : A Prospective Cohort Study
articles.authors: Ahmad M, Cleland JGF, Maffia P, Strawbridge RJ, Sattar N, Pell JP, Liu Q, Friday JM, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The 1959 World Health Organization (WHO) definition of anemia is widely used, but its relationship with mortality in the general adult population is uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 1959年世界衛生組織（ WHO ）對貧血的定義被廣泛使用，但其與一般成年人羣死亡率的關係尚不確定。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate associations between baseline hemoglobin concentration and long-term mortality by age and sex.
abstract.textZh: 按年齡和性別評估基線血紅蛋白濃度與長期死亡率之間的關聯。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Prospective cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Population-based cohort in the United Kingdom.
abstract.textZh: 英國的人口基礎羣組。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 502 188 adults (median age, 58 years; 54.4% women) recruited from 2006 to 2010; hemoglobin concentration was measured in 477 876 (95.2%). Analyses were stratified by sex and age (<60 vs. ≥60 years). Median follow-up was 13.6 years.
abstract.textZh: 從2006年至2010年招募了502 188名成人（中位年齡， 58歲； 54.4%婦女） ；在477 876 （ 95.2% ）中測量了血紅蛋白濃度。分析按性別和年齡分層（ < 60 vs. ≥ 60歲）。中位隨訪時間為13.6年。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Hemoglobin concentration categorized relative to WHO sex-specific thresholds (men, <13.0 g/dL; women, <12.0 g/dL). Outcomes were all-cause, cardiovascular, and cancer mortality.
abstract.textZh: 血紅蛋白濃度相對於WHO性別特異性閾值分類（男性， < 13.0 g/dL ；女性， < 12.0 g/dL ）。結果為全因、心血管和癌症死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: All-cause mortality showed a U-shaped association with hemoglobin concentration, with lowest risk 1 to 3 g/dL above the WHO threshold. In the primary adjusted model, the 10-year standardized cumulative incidence (SCI) was 4.5% in the reference group versus 12.5% among participants more than 2 g/dL below the threshold (absolute risk difference [ARD], +8.1 percentage points; 95% CI, 6.7 to 9.4 percentage points); over the entire follow-up, the adjusted hazard ratio (HR) was 2.87 (CI, 2.54 to 3.25). Among those 0 to 1 g/dL above the threshold, the 10-year SCI was 5.3% (ARD, +0.8 percentage points; CI, 0.7 to 1.0 percentage points) and the adjusted HR was 1.18 (CI, 1.15 to 1.21). Associations were less consistent in women younger than 60 years. Patterns for cardiovascular and cancer mortality were similar at low and borderline concentrations but attenuated at higher concentrations.
abstract.textZh: 全因死亡率與血紅蛋白濃度呈U形關聯，最低風險高於WHO閾值1至3 g/dL。在主要調整模型中，參照組的10年標準化累積發生率(SCI)為4.5% ，大於閾值2 g/dL的參與者為12.5% (絕對風險差[ARD] ， +8.1個百分點； 95% CI ， 6.7至9.4個百分點) ；在整個隨訪期間，調整後風險比(HR)為2.87 (CI ， 2.54至3.25)。在高於閾值的0至1 g/dL中， 10年SCI為5.3% （ ARD ， +0.8個百分點； CI ， 0.7至1.0個百分點） ，調整後的HR為1.18 （ CI ， 1.15至1.21 ）。在60歲以下的女性中，相關性不太一致。心血管和癌症死亡率的模式在低濃度和邊緣濃度下相似，但在較高濃度下減弱。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Single baseline hemoglobin concentration measurement; predominantly White population.
abstract.textZh: 單一基線期血紅蛋白濃度測量；主要是白人族羣。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Mortality was lowest at hemoglobin concentrations 1 to 3 g/dL above current WHO thresholds, with higher mortality below and above this range. These hypothesis-generating findings should not define new thresholds but may inform clinical interpretation and evaluation of borderline hemoglobin concentration values.
abstract.textZh: 當血紅蛋白濃度高於目前的WHO閾值1至3 g/dL時，死亡率最低，低於和高於此範圍的死亡率更高。這些假設產生的結果不應定義新的閾值，但可以為臨牀解釋和邊緣血紅蛋白濃度值的評估提供信息。

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: None.
abstract.textZh: 無。

articles.titleZh: 按年齡和性別劃分的血紅蛋白濃度與死亡率之間的關聯：一項前瞻性隊列研究
